title: Manager - Payroll & Compliance
description:
**About Us**
Finance in a Box is an Accounting \& Financial Consulting firm based in California, USA. We provide outsourced CFO/Controller services to companies around the world. In addition, we assist companies with building accounting teams.**Job\-Overview***Job Title:* ***Manager \- Payroll \& Compliance****Job Location:* ***Gandhinagar****Experience:* ***Minimum 10 years****Function:* ***Payroll, Statutory Compliance \& HR Operations****Employment Type:* ***Full\-time***
We are looking for a highly experienced and hands\-on Payroll \& Compliance Manager to lead payroll and employee statutory compliance for both our internal organization and external clients across India.
The role requires deep expertise in end\-to\-end payroll processing, labour law compliance, statutory filings, audits, employee taxation, payroll controls, and client management. The ideal candidate should be capable of independently managing multiple payrolls, handling complex employee cases, ensuring zero compliance gaps, and acting as a subject matter expert for clients and internal stakeholders.**Key Responsibilities****Payroll Management*** Own end\-to\-end monthly payroll processing for internal employees and multiple external clients across India.
* Manage payroll inputs, validations, deductions, reimbursements, variable pay, incentives, bonuses, arrears and full \& final settlements.
* Ensure accurate and timely salary processing within agreed payroll timelines.
* Review payroll registers, variance reports and reconciliation statements before payroll release.
* Manage employee taxation including TDS calculations, investment declarations, Form 16 and related payroll tax requirements.
* Handle payroll\-related employee queries and complex payroll escalations.
* Ensure strong maker\-checker processes and payroll controls.
* Coordinate with finance teams for payroll funding, accounting inputs and reconciliation.

**Statutory \& Employee Compliance*** Ensure complete compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements across India.
* Manage compliance related to PF, ESIC, Professional Tax, Labour Welfare Fund, Gratuity, Bonus, Maternity Benefits, Shops \& Establishments and other applicable employment regulations.
* Ensure timely statutory registrations, payments, returns and filings.
* Maintain statutory registers, records and documentation required under applicable labour laws.
* Monitor changes in labour laws and advise internal teams and clients on implications and required actions.
* Support implementation and readiness for applicable Labour Codes and regulatory changes.

**Client Payroll \& Compliance Management*** Independently manage payroll and compliance requirements for multiple client organizations.
* Act as the primary payroll and compliance SPOC for assigned clients.
* Understand client\-specific policies, salary structures and compliance requirements.
* Manage payroll calendars, client inputs, payroll sign\-offs and statutory deliverables.
* Conduct regular payroll and compliance reviews with clients.
* Identify compliance risks and proactively recommend corrective actions.
* Handle client escalations with maturity, accuracy and strong subject matter expertise.

**Audits \& Governance*** Lead payroll and statutory compliance audits.
* Ensure payroll documentation and compliance records are audit\-ready at all times.
* Support internal, external, statutory and client audits.
* Develop strong SOPs, checklists, payroll calendars and compliance trackers.
* Drive process improvement and automation within payroll and compliance operations.
* Ensure data confidentiality and adherence to appropriate payroll data controls.

**Required Experience \& Skills*** Minimum 10 years of hands\-on experience in payroll and statutory compliance.
* Strong experience managing multi\-client or multi\-entity payroll operations.
* Deep knowledge of Indian payroll practices and labour law compliance.
* Strong working knowledge of PF, ESIC, PT, LWF, Bonus, Gratuity, TDS, Shops \& Establishments and related regulations.
* Experience handling payroll for employees across multiple Indian states.
* Strong knowledge of salary structures, CTC components, taxation and full \& final settlement.
* Experience managing statutory inspections, notices and compliance audits will be highly preferred.
* Strong Excel skills and experience working with payroll/HRMS platforms.
* Excellent attention to detail, numerical accuracy and process discipline.
* Strong client communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to independently handle escalations and advise clients on payroll and compliance matters.

**Preferred Background*** Experience with a payroll outsourcing company, HR consulting firm, professional services organization or shared services environment.
* Experience managing payroll for multiple clients simultaneously.

description:
Job description:

**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Salary:** ₹15,000 – ₹20,000 per month, based on experience  
**Work Mode:** Work From Home  
**Working Hours:** Night Shift

**About Us**

At NextGenApply.AI, we use AI to make job applications faster, smarter, and easier for job seekers across the U.S. Our growing team works remotely across recruitment, operations, job applications, and AI\-driven workflows.

We’re looking for an HR Operations Specialist to manage day\-to\-day HR activities and ensure smooth employee operations. This role involves recruitment coordination, employee lifecycle management, onboarding, documentation, attendance and leave tracking, employee engagement, and supporting managers and employees with HR\-related requirements.

**What You’ll Do**

* Manage day\-to\-day HR operations and employee lifecycle activities from onboarding to exit
* Coordinate recruitment activities, including candidate screening, interview scheduling, follow\-ups, and hiring documentation
* Prepare and maintain employee records, contracts, offer letters, appointment letters, and other HR documents
* Coordinate employee onboarding and ensure required documents and information are collected
* Maintain accurate employee databases, attendance, leave, probation, and contract records
* Handle employee queries related to leave, attendance, onboarding, policies, and HR processes
* Track employee probation periods, confirmations, promotions, salary revisions, and contract renewals
* Coordinate resignation, notice periods, exit formalities, and required documentation
* Maintain HR trackers and reports using Excel/Google Sheets or HRMS platforms
* Support the implementation and communication of HR policies and procedures
* Monitor employee compliance with company processes and documentation requirements
* Coordinate with Team Leads, Managers, and Operations teams on employee\-related matters
* Prepare regular HR reports and provide management with accurate employee data and updates
* Identify operational gaps and improve HR processes for better efficiency and accuracy
* Maintain confidentiality of employee and company information

**What We’re Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business Administration, or a related field
* 1–3 years of experience in HR Operations or a similar role
* Good understanding of recruitment and employee lifecycle processes
* Strong knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets and HRMS platforms
* Good written and verbal communication skills
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
* Ability to manage multiple HR activities and deadlines simultaneously
* Good problem\-solving and decision\-making skills
* Ability to handle confidential employee information professionally
* Self\-motivated, responsible, and comfortable working in a remote environment
* Experience with recruitment, onboarding, employee documentation, and HR operations is an advantage

**Why You’ll Love Working With Us**

* Permanent Work From Home role
* 5\-day work week with weekends off
* Opportunity to work across HR, Recruitment, and Operations
* Growth opportunities in a fast\-growing company
* Supportive and collaborative work environment
* Exposure to modern HRMS and AI\-driven business operations
* Performance\-based recognition and growth opportunities

Pay: Up to ₹20,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Work from home

title: Global Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
**About the Role**



Globalli is seeking an experienced Global Talent Acquisition Partner to join our People team and support hiring across our growing, multinational organization. This role will report to the HR Manager and partner closely with hiring managers across Technology, Go\-to\-Market, HR/Workforce Management, and corporate functions.



This is a hands\-on talent acquisition role for someone who is comfortable working across different functions, seniority levels, countries, and time zones. The ideal candidate understands how recruiting works in a multinational environment and can adapt sourcing and hiring practices to different talent markets while maintaining a consistent, high\-quality candidate experience.



You will manage the recruiting process from role intake and sourcing through interviews, offer coordination, and onboarding handoff, while keeping hiring managers informed and ensuring our ATS and recruiting data remain accurate and current.


**What You'll Do**



Global Talent Acquisition


* Manage full\-cycle recruiting for roles across Technology, Go\-to\-Market, HR/Workforce Management, and corporate functions.
* Partner with hiring managers to understand business needs, define role requirements, establish interview processes, and develop realistic hiring timelines.
* Develop sourcing strategies based on the role, location, seniority, and local talent market.
* Source both active and passive candidates through LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, professional networks, referrals, and other sourcing channels.
* Conduct candidate screening and initial interviews, assess qualifications against established requirements, and provide clear candidate feedback to hiring managers.
* Coordinate interviews and maintain momentum throughout the hiring process.
* Manage offer processes in partnership with the HR Manager and hiring managers.
* Complete recruiting activities and provide a clear handoff to HR for onboarding and new hire setup.
* Maintain consistent communication with candidates throughout the process and help deliver a strong candidate experience.


Global \& Multinational Recruiting


* Recruit across multiple countries and regions, including North America, LATAM, EMEA, and APAC.
* Understand how recruiting practices, talent availability, compensation expectations, employment considerations, and time zones can differ by market.
* Build and maintain talent pipelines in both established and emerging hiring markets.
* Coordinate effectively with candidates and hiring managers across multiple time zones.
* Develop practical sourcing strategies that balance talent quality, location, and cost considerations.


Recruiting Operations \& Process


* Manage candidate activity and workflows in Greenhouse, ensuring accurate candidate records, stage movement, interview feedback, and data hygiene.
* Create and maintain job postings, candidate outreach, interview plans, and scorecards.
* Track recruiting activity and provide regular reporting on pipeline health, time\-to\-fill, offers, hiring activity, and sourcing effectiveness.
* Help identify opportunities to improve recruiting processes, candidate experience, and hiring manager effectiveness.
* Maintain organized recruiting documentation and ensure processes are followed consistently.
* Support recruiting projects and process improvements as the company and hiring needs evolve.


Employer Branding \& Talent Engagement


* Develop compelling candidate outreach and job postings that accurately represent Globalli and the opportunity.
* Help strengthen Globalli's presence in relevant talent markets and professional communities.
* Support employee referrals, social sourcing, and other initiatives that expand our talent pipeline.


**What You'll Bring**



Must\-Have Qualifications


* 3\+ years of full\-cycle talent acquisition/recruiting experience, preferably in a fast\-paced technology, SaaS, startup, or multinational environment.
* Demonstrated experience recruiting across multiple functions, such as Technology, GTM/Sales, HR/Operations, Finance, or other professional roles.
* Experience managing the recruiting lifecycle from intake through onboarding handoff.
* Experience recruiting across multiple countries or international talent markets.
* Strong sourcing experience, including hands\-on use of LinkedIn Recruiter and other sourcing tools.
* Experience working with an ATS, preferably Greenhouse, including candidate tracking, workflow management, reporting, and data hygiene.
* Strong candidate assessment, communication, and relationship\-building skills.
* Ability to independently manage multiple open requisitions and competing priorities.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Comfortable working directly with hiring managers and clarifying or challenging requirements when needed.
* Fluent English, written and spoken.
* Reliable internet and a professional home\-office environment.
* Ability to maintain meaningful working\-hour overlap with the New York/Eastern Time zone.


Preferred Qualifications


* Experience recruiting for a global technology, SaaS, fintech, HR\-tech, payroll, or workforce management company.
* Technical recruiting experience, including engineering, SRE/infrastructure, data, or cloud roles.
* Experience recruiting GTM roles, including Sales, Account Management, Customer Success, Partnerships, or Marketing.
* Experience recruiting HR, payroll, implementation, workforce management, or other operational roles.
* Experience recruiting across North America, LATAM, EMEA, and/or APAC.
* Spanish or another widely spoken business language.
* Experience recruiting in a remote\-first or distributed organization.
* Experience working with compensation benchmarks and adapting recruiting strategies to different geographic markets.
* Experience supporting employer branding, talent communities, or recruiting analytics.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 HSE INTEGRO is a specialized provider of integrated Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) services designed to protect workers, assets, and communities in a structured and cost\-effective way. Acting as a one\-stop shop, the company supports organizations in meeting diverse HSE requirements under a single umbrella. Its consultants bring deep domain expertise to help clients implement best practices and strengthen existing policies and standard operating procedures. HSE INTEGRO focuses on practical, results\-oriented solutions that enhance organizational safety culture and regulatory compliance.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 The Human Resources Manager at HSE INTEGRO will oversee end\-to\-end HR operations, including recruitment, onboarding, performance management, and employee engagement. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include developing and implementing HR policies, managing employee relations, handling disciplinary and grievance procedures, and ensuring compliance with labor laws and company standards. The role involves partnering with leadership to support workforce planning, talent development, and organizational culture initiatives aligned with the company’s HSE\-focused mission. The Human Resources Manager will also maintain HR records, manage payroll inputs and benefits coordination in collaboration with finance, and support training programs for staff. This is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Mumbai.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Strong skills in recruitment, talent acquisition, and onboarding to build and sustain a high\-performing team.
* Experience in performance management, employee engagement, and retention strategies to support a positive workplace culture.
* Proficiency in HR policy development, labor law compliance, and handling employee relations, grievances, and disciplinary processes.
* Ability to manage HR data, maintain accurate records, and work with HRIS or related HR software for reporting and analytics.
* Excellent interpersonal, communication, and conflict\-resolution skills, with the ability to collaborate across departments and levels.
* Demonstrated capability in organizing and supporting training and development initiatives, ideally in safety, compliance, or related areas.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; a postgraduate qualification or HR certification is an advantage.
* Previous 10 Years experience as an HR generalist or HR manager, preferably within consulting, professional services, or HSE\-related sectors.

title: Regional HR Manager
description:
**About bigbasket**




**bigbasket, a Tata Enterprise,** 
 is one of India’s pioneers in online grocery, transforming the way millions of Indians shop every day. It is at the forefront of transforming quick commerce in India
 



  





 With
 **50,000\+ employees,** 
 presence across
 **60\+ cities and towns** 
 and
 **15 million customer orders per month** 
 , we operate across grocery, fresh retail, quick commerce and B2B. Our ecosystem includes 7 business verticals \-
 **bigbasket, bbnow, bbdaily, bbinstant, Fresho, bbmandi and bbsaathi.** 
 From pioneering online grocery to building next\-generation commerce, we continue to innovate at scale. Backed by the
 **Tata Group** 
 , we combine the trust of a legacy brand with the agility and ambition to build what’s next.
 



  





**Join bigbasket. Build what’s next** 




  





**Role Details**




**Reporting To :** 
 Lead HR \- West
 



**Location :** 
 Mumbai
 



**Work Model :** 
 Onsite
 



  





**What would you be doing?**




 The
 **Regional HR Manager** 
 will lead the HR function for the designated Mumbai region at bigbasket, partnering closely with business leaders to drive people strategy, organizational effectiveness and employee experience. The role will own the end\-to\-end employee lifecycle and ensure alignment of HR priorities with business goals and growth plans.
 



  




* **HR Strategy \& Business Partnering:**



 Develop and execute regional HR strategies aligned with business priorities. Partner with regional and functional leaders to address people priorities and drive organizational effectiveness.
 



  




* **Workforce Planning \& Talent Acquisition:**



 Partner with business leaders on workforce planning, manpower requirements and talent needs. Drive timely hiring in collaboration with the Talent Acquisition team.
 



  




* **Employee Engagement \& Relations:**



 Drive employee engagement initiatives and foster a positive, inclusive work environment. Address employee concerns, grievances and disciplinary matters in a fair and timely manner.
 



  




* **Performance \& Talent Management:**



 Drive performance management, goal\-setting and talent review processes. Identify high\-potential talent and support career development and succession planning.
 



  




* **Learning \& Development:**



 Identify regional capability\-building needs and partner with L\&D teams to drive relevant development interventions and learning programs.
 



  




* **HR Operations \& Compliance:**



 Ensure effective execution of HR processes and adherence to company policies and applicable employment laws and regulations. Partner with relevant teams to mitigate people\-related risks.
 



  




* **HR Analytics \& Insights:**



 Track and analyse key people metrics such as attrition, headcount, engagement and workforce trends. Provide actionable insights to business and HR leadership.
 



  




* **Cross\-functional Collaboration:**



 Work closely with HR COEs and business teams to implement people initiatives and support organizational priorities. Act as a trusted HR partner to regional leadership.
 



  





**Who are we looking for?**




  




* Postgraduate/Master’s degree in Human Resources or a related field.
* **10–15 years of experience** 
 in HR, with strong experience in HRBP and regional HR leadership roles.
* Experience in
 **E\-commerce, Retail, FMCG, Logistics or Supply Chain** 
 would be preferred.
* Strong understanding of HR practices, employee lifecycle and employment regulations.
* Proven ability to partner with senior business leaders and translate business priorities into people initiatives.
* Strategic thinking with strong problem\-solving and execution capabilities.
* Ability to operate effectively in a
 **fast\-paced, dynamic and high\-growth environment** 
 .



  





**Interested?**




 At bigbasket, you’ll have the opportunity to work at scale, solve meaningful business challenges and help shape the future of commerce in India.
 



  





 Join us and be part of the team building what’s next at bigbasket.

Seeking an experienced professional in learning design and development to join our team as a Global Learning Design and Development Project Manager, Assistant Director.



EY’s Global Learning function designs, develops and deploys technical and non\-technical learning for EY professionals across the world. In the Design and development team, we are applying learning science and proven technology in the development and curation of the best learning content.



We are looking for a colleague to join our virtual team working from over 20 geographical locations across the world. We offer flexible working, the chance to work in a multicultural and multinational environment, and best in class teaming and collaboration.

  


**The opportunity**



This role in the global learning team that will give you the opportunity to make a difference by helping EY professionals globally grow their skills and accelerate their careers.



This position is responsible for project management of design, development and curation of individual learning items and blended learning programs. The project manager will monitor the progress of instructional designers, developers, graphic artists, quality assurance specialists and all others associated with the design process. They will assist portfolio design leads and managers in overseeing and managing all design activities necessary to deliver learning products that meet EY’s design quality standards, on time and to budget. The project manager will also work to a set of agreed project management standards and processes and will share best practices to support the continuous improvement of design and development speed, efficiency, and quality. The project manager, Assistant Director, will be able to manage autonomously, with limited need for supervision.



This role will provide the opportunity to work in a dynamic, fast paced environment supporting multiple projects at a time.

  


**Your key responsibilities**


* Deliver learning design and development projects (including large scale, highly complex projects) on time, to budget and quality standards
* Develop a detailed project plan for each project, based on a standard template, identifying deliverable due dates and review cycles
* Establish and maintain relationships with a variety of stakeholders including subject matter resources, other learning stakeholders, and third\-party learning vendors
* Ensure adherence to operations and compliance processes including procurement, finance, and Risk Management
* Coordinate and monitor the work of vendor project managers, designers, and developers where applicable
* Identify and assess risks and consult with leadership or stakeholders on options in a timely manner
* Facilitate and lead regular project and team meetings
* Create and maintain comprehensive project documentation
* Leverage and share best practices of project management with other team members
* Mentor and provide guidance to junior project managers on the team
* Make recommendations to leadership regarding competing priorities and resource management issues
* Initiate and ensure the effective and timely publication of learning content by content administration
* Measure project performance using appropriate systems, tools, and techniques

  


**Skills and attributes for success**

  


**To qualify for the role you must have:**


* Minimum of 8\-10 years of experience in managing learning design and development projects, preferably at a global level and/or to a dispersed client base
* Demonstrable experience involving project management skills including management of vendors
* Demonstrable experience in concurrently managing multiple, large\-scale, and highly complex learning and development projects involving all delivery channels/types
* Demonstrable experience using project management software, including Microsoft Excel
* Demonstrable experience of having built and maintained strong relationships with business customers/clients, including at the senior or c\-suite level
* Demonstrable experience of thinking and acting strategically and commercially in pursuit of the wider EY business objectives
* Demonstratable experience of mentoring and providing guidance to junior team members

  


**Ideally, you’ll also have**


* Strong knowledge of \- and commitment to optimize \- learning end\-to\-end processes and standards
* Knowledge of learning science and evidence\-based design standards and practices to ensure that EY’s learning content is of the highest quality and has the desired business impact
* A bachelor’s degree and ideally higher professional or master’s qualification in a related discipline

  


**What we look for**


* An experienced project manager who strives to improve process and exceed leadership’s needs
* A professional who can quickly problem solve and can offer perspective on solutions
* A professional who demonstrates resilience and is energized by working in a global environment, proactively seeking different opinions, valuing, and leveraging diverse perspectives

As part of this role, you'll work in a highly integrated, global team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial, and social well\-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here’s a snapshot of what we offer:


* **Continuous learning:** You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* **Success as defined by you:** We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* **Transformative leadership:** We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* **Diverse and inclusive culture:** You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

  


**EY \| Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  


Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.  

Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts


**Who You Are:**

  


The Talent Management Partner will independently own execution of workstreams across performance, careers, compensation, and broader talent initiatives. This is a hands\-on role for someone who combines strong analytical capability with sound judgment and can support translation of talent problems into scalable solutions, through close partnership with PBPs and functional leaders.


**What You’ll Be Doing:**


**Performance \& Careers**


* Apply established job evaluation frameworks to evaluate roles, document rationale, and flag cases requiring calibration for levelling decisions.
* Maintain job architectures, career paths, level descriptors and progression criteria; incorporate approved changes and maintain version control/source of truth.
* Partner with People Business Partners (PBPs) to track architecture gaps and recommend changes when the nature or complexity of work materially evolves.
* Independently own execution of assigned modules during performance and promotion review cycles.
* Analyze talent outcomes to identify patterns, inconsistencies, and opportunities for improvement.


**Compensation \& Rewards**


* Conduct market benchmarking using global data platforms to support compensation recommendations.
* Analyze compensation and talent data to support pay range design, hiring, retention, promotion, and workforce decisions.
* Apply established compensation principles consistently while identifying and escalating exceptions, inconsistencies, and emerging organizational patterns.
* Maintain equity/rewards datasets, run defined analyses and support reporting for strategic rewards initiatives.


**Project Coordination \& Data Analytics**


* Maintain project plans, trackers, dependencies, schedules and completion reporting across talent management initiatives.
* Build scalable dashboards and standardized reporting templates across initiatives.
* Use Apps Script, GPT/API\-based workflows and other automation tools to reduce manual work across recurring analysis, reporting, data validation and talent operations.
* Build and maintain automated data pipelines between talent datasets and reporting outputs, with appropriate data quality and exception flags.


**Stakeholder Consulting**


* Serve as the first point of support for PBPs on established talent processes, data and frameworks; resolve standard queries and escalate judgment\-heavy cases.
* Analyze issues, validate data and develop options/inputs for decision\-making.
* Maintain documentation and templates that enable consistent application of Talent Management processes.


**What We’re Looking For**


* 5\+ years of progressive experience in Talent Management, Compensation/Rewards, People Consulting, Performance, Organization Design, or related disciplines.
* Hands\-on compensation experience across market benchmarking, salary structures and pay design.
* Working knowledge of job evaluation methodologies, such as Aon, Korn Ferry/Hay, Mercer IPE, or equivalent.
* Strong analytical and modeling capability with advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills and the ability to translate complex data into actionable recommendations.
* Aptitude to create basic Appscript/ChatGPT API\-Based workflows to reduce manual effort in recurring tasks.
* Knowledge of career architecture, leveling, performance, and organization design principles.
* Strong stakeholder consulting and communication to explain complex concepts clearly.
* Ability to navigate ambiguity and exercise sound judgment when applying talent and compensation principles.
* Experience working in a global workforce.


**Preferred**


* Experience in talent/rewards consulting, including Mercer, Aon, WTW, Korn Ferry, Big 4 People Advisory, or similar.
* Experience in SaaS, technology, or another high\-growth environment.
* Exposure to equity compensation, global compensation, or pay\-equity analysis.
* Experience designing or scaling enterprise career, performance, or talent frameworks.

 Join Amazon's Builder Experience Team (BeXT) as a Data Center HR Partner and make every day better for the Builders who power AWS. * Adaptability. Manage multiple scenarios utilizing HR expertise, consulting skills, and influence.

* Influencing. Influence multiple levels of the organization, from builders to senior site leaders, without direct authority.
* Coaching. Develop site leadership in the flow of work.


 This is a 100% Onsite role and requires the ability to travel to assigned Data Center sites within an operational cluster (estimated 25% travel).
   

  

* Data Center environments are 24/7 operational facilities; flexibility to support off\-shift populations and respond to time\-sensitive people matters is expected.
* This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports; leadership is demonstrated through influence, mentorship, and cross\-functional partnership.


 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Builder Advocacy: Build trust through consistent floor/onsite presence, site walks \& Gemba walks. Proactively monitor Builder sentiment trends using listening mechanisms. Support Builder queries with discretion and expertise. Foster and role model an environment of inclusion for all Builders, ensuring they feel fully engaged in their work and valued for who they are. Establish relationships with employee representative boards.
   

  

 Strategic Partnership: Partner with Data Center leaders at multiple levels to develop proactive strategies and goals focused on the Builder experience. Identify root causes using sentiment trends and HR data and provide site\-level recommendations to site leadership. Coordinate cluster\-wide communications in partnership with site leadership. Present at monthly All Manager and All Team Meetings.
   

  

 HR Expertise: Apply HR fundamentals to problem\-solve across talent management, performance management, compensation, and employee relations. Resolve complex cases independently, navigating Amazon Policies with high judgment. Conduct workplace investigations in collaboration with Builder Relations. Resolve systemic pay, internal transfer, and hiring defects in partnership with central teams. Build procedural policy/governance standards (e.g., SOPs).
   

  

 Leadership Development: Consult, coach, and develop site leadership through decision\-making with empathy and sound judgment. Identify development opportunities through data and anecdotal feedback from onsite floor walks and observation. Educate leaders on HR operating model standards.  A day in the life
   

  

 You'll conduct weekly Gemba walks, engaging directly with Builders to understand their experience. You'll consult and coach leadership through talent management, performance management, compensation decisions, and employee relations issues—applying empathy and sound judgment. * Demonstrated experience in employee relations including conducting investigations and managing complex, high\-risk ER cases

**Nomura Overview:**

  

Nomura is an Asia\-headquartered financial services group with an integrated global network spanning over 30 countries. By connecting markets East \& West, Nomura services the needs of individuals, institutions, corporates and governments through its four business divisions: Retail, Asset Management, Wholesale (Global Markets and Investment Banking), and Merchant Banking. For further information about Nomura, visit www.nomura.com

  

Nomura Services India, (Powai) supports Nomura’s businesses around the world. Powai’ s world class capabilities in trading support, research, information technology, financial control, operations, risk management and legal support have played a key role in facilitating Nomura’s global operations and are an integral part of Nomura’s global expansion plans. The Powai operation is a critical part of the platform to support the growth of Nomura’s global business.


**Division Overview:**

  

The Operations division provides the support and control infrastructure that enables the Firm to develop and deliver financial products throughout the world. Working with the Sales, Trading and Information Technology Divisions, Operations professionals are responsible for the management and execution of transactions in a manner which maximizes profitability and minimizes risk. Our division is responsible for the management and execution of millions of securities transactions on a daily basis. Our responsibilities include trade processing, confirmation, settlement, fails management, margin, asset servicing, risk management, reference data management and various other client services. In partnership with sales, trading, prime services, information technology and other teams from across the bank, we apply a continual focus on improving productivity and efficiency, while seeking new and innovative ways to support our clients' changing needs.

The role of Shared Services is to support the activities of the Global Markets and IBD businesses. The division operates across a large number of global legal entities in order to perform a diverse range of client servicing, risk management and regulatory functions, as well as the more traditional clearing and settlement responsibilities. Specifically India Shared Services provides a level of support for all the regions and entities that the above services are provided in locally. title: AI/ML Engineer
description:
The AI/ML Engineer will design, develop, and validate machine learning models that support product features and internal analytics. Working closely with data engineers and product owners, the engineer translates business requirements into data pipelines, feature sets, and model prototypes. The role owns end\-to\-end model development for assigned use cases, including data preparation, algorithm selection, training, evaluation, and documentation. By monitoring model performance in production, the engineer helps identify drift and suggests improvements. This position requires independent execution of defined projects, clear communication of technical findings, and collaboration with cross‑functional teams to ensure models meet accuracy and reliability standards.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Gather and clean structured and unstructured data sets required for model training, documenting data lineage and quality checks.
* Develop feature engineering pipelines using Python and pandas to create reproducible inputs for machine learning algorithms.
* Select, implement, and fine‑tune supervised learning models (e.g., regression, classification) with scikit\-learn or TensorFlow, adhering to project constraints.
* Conduct systematic model evaluation, generating performance reports and visualizations for stakeholder review.
* Write reusable code modules and unit tests, maintaining version control with Git and following team coding standards.
* Deploy trained models to a staging environment using Docker containers and validate inference latency and resource usage.
* Monitor deployed models for performance decay, collect feedback, and propose retraining or parameter adjustments.
* Collaborate with product managers to translate business objectives into measurable model success criteria.
* Document model architecture, training procedures, and operational guidelines in the team's knowledge base.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Statistics, or a related quantitative field.
* 1 to 2 years of professional experience building and deploying machine learning models.
* Proficiency in Python programming, including libraries such as pandas, NumPy, and scikit\-learn.
* Experience with at least one deep learning framework (TensorFlow or PyTorch).
* Demonstrated ability to write clear, maintainable code and use Git for version control.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret model results and communicate findings to non‑technical stakeholders.


**Required Skills**
* Data preprocessing and feature engineering
* Model selection, training, and hyperparameter tuning
* Performance evaluation metrics (accuracy, precision, recall, AUC)
* Version control with Git
* Containerization basics using Docker
* Clear technical documentation and reporting


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's degree in a quantitative discipline.
* Experience with cloud services for data storage or model hosting (e.g., AWS S3, Azure Blob).
* Exposure to MLOps tools such as MLflow or Kubeflow.
* Published project or paper demonstrating end‑to‑end machine learning workflow.


**Preferred Skills**
* Time‑series forecasting techniques
* Natural language processing using spaCy or Hugging Face Transformers
* Automated testing of model pipelines
* Knowledge of SQL for data extraction

title: IOS QA Manual Tester
description:
****About The Role****
 We are looking for a
 **QA Tester** 
 to own day\-to\-day quality of our
 **iOS** 
 application. You will write and execute test cases, manage test work in
 **Azure DevOps** 
 , and use
 **SQL Server** 
 to set up data, check results, and prove defects. You will partner with product, iOS development, and QA to catch issues before release and keep test evidence in ADO.
   

  

 This role is execution\-led: you turn stories and acceptance criteria into runnable tests, run them on real devices, and back pass/fail with SQL Server evidence.
   

  

****What You Will Do****
**iOS testing**
* Write and execute functional, regression, smoke, exploratory, and negative tests for the iOS app.
* Test on physical iPhones and the iOS Simulator; cover agreed iOS versions, device sizes, and orientations.
* Validate iOS behavior: login, permissions (camera, photos, location, notifications), backgrounding, app kill/relaunch, rotation, Dark Mode, Dynamic Type, locale/timezone, and TestFlight vs debug builds.
* Test offline/online sync, poor network, and data that must round\-trip from the device to the backend and back.
* Reproduce and isolate iOS defects with clear steps, screenshots, screen recordings, device/OS/build, and Console / crash evidence where available.
* Perform risk\-based regression on high\-impact journeys before each release.
* Partner with developers on build availability, environment issues, and device\-specific failures.
* Contribute to go/no\-go input for iOS releases.


**Azure DevOps**
* Author and maintain test cases, test suites, and test plans in Azure DevOps Test Plans.
* Link tests and bugs to PBIs, user stories, and bugs on Azure Boards; keep work items accurate through the sprint.
* Execute test runs, record pass / fail / blocked, and attach evidence in ADO.
* Log defects with severity/priority, repro steps, expected vs actual, iOS device/OS/build, and linked work items.
* Track testing progress against sprint/release scope; flag blocked tests and environment issues early.


**SQL Server**
* Write SQL Queries against SQL Server (SELECT, JOIN, WHERE, GROUP BY, aggregations) to verify what the iOS app saved.
* Use SQL Server to set up and reset test data (accounts, jobs, sites, statuses, dates) in QA following data\-safety rules.
* Confirm create/update/delete and sync: device action vs rows in SQL Server.
* Investigate data mismatches (wrong counts, stale rows, timezone/datetime, missing FKs) and attach query results to bugs.
* Validate lists, reports, and widgets against SQL Server source data, not UI\-only checks.
* Use SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS) or Azure Data Studio for day\-to\-day query work.


**Quality process**
* Translate acceptance criteria into test cases, including edge cases and negative paths.
* Keep a living iOS regression suite; retire obsolete cases and add coverage when features change.
* Communicate status, risks, and defect trends in standups and release reviews.
* Document tests so another tester can run the same suite without tribal knowledge.


****Required Qualifications****
* 3\+ years software QA experience, including 2\+ years hands\-on iOS testing (native or hybrid).
* Proven experience writing and executing manual iOS test cases (functional, regression, exploratory).
* Hands\-on Azure DevOps: Boards (work items, queries, linking) and Test Plans (test cases, suites, runs, results).
* Hands\-on SQL Server and T\-SQL: querying, joins, filters, and using results to validate application behavior.
* Comfort with SSMS (or Azure Data Studio) against QA/staging databases.
* Strong defect writing: clear repro, expected vs actual, severity, iOS device/OS/build, and attachments.
* Experience testing on physical iPhones plus Simulator when appropriate.
* Strong written communication; ability to work independently, prioritize risk, and meet release deadlines.


****Preferred Qualifications****
* IoT with a mobile app: pairing, telemetry, firmware, Bluetooth/BLE, sensors, or similar peripherals.
* Offline\-first / field\-service iOS apps (sync, conflict handling, poor network).
* Azure DevOps advanced use: shared steps, parameters, configurations (device/OS), dashboards, and queries.
* SQL Server beyond basics: views, stored procedures (execute and interpret results), subqueries.
* iOS diagnostics: Console, crash logs, TestFlight, Proxyman/Charles, or similar.
* API testing (Postman, REST) used alongside UI and SQL Server checks.
* Familiarity with Appium or other mobile automation — execution or collaboration, not necessarily ownership.
* Accessibility (VoiceOver, Dynamic Type) and localization testing on iOS.
* Domain experience in \[field service / SaaS / pest control / regulated industry — insert if relevant].
* ISTQB or equivalent (nice to have).

 A DevOps engineer is a professional who is responsible for the continuous delivery and deployment of software in an agile team. * Knowledge of networking and security best practices
* Understanding of DevOps culture and Agile methodologies

title: Member of Technical Staff
description:
**About ThoughtSpot** 




 ThoughtSpot is the leader in Agentic Analytics, helping organizations turn natural language into governed, trusted insight through Spotter and our broader analytics platform. Headquartered in Mountain View, California, with hubs across North America, EMEA, and India, we're a fast\-growing B2B SaaS company built on continuous innovation and a genuine passion for making AI work for the people who use it every day.
 



  





**Member of Technical Staff** 




**About the Role** 




 At ThoughtSpot, we're building the future of analytics with AI at the core. As a
 **Member of Technical Staff** 
 , you'll join a team of world\-class engineers working on technologies that power our next\-generation analytics platform. From distributed systems and high\-performance backend services to AI\-powered search and natural language understanding, you'll work on challenging engineering problems at scale while learning from experienced mentors. This is an opportunity to build products that are used by some of the world's leading enterprises and make an impact from day one.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend systems that process large volumes of data with high performance and reliability.
* Build production\-grade software using languages such as
 **Java, Go, Python, or C\+\+** 
 .
* Contribute to the design, implementation, testing, and deployment of core platform components.
* Improve the scalability, performance, and reliability of distributed systems.
* Write clean, maintainable, and well\-tested code following engineering best practices.
* Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, debugging, and problem\-solving with experienced engineers.
* Collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams in a fast\-paced, agile environment.



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related engineering discipline.
* Strong foundation in
 **Data Structures, Algorithms, Object\-Oriented Programming, and Software Engineering** 
 .
* Good understanding of core Computer Science fundamentals, including
 **Operating Systems, Computer Networks, Databases, and Distributed Systems** 
 .
* Proficiency in at least one programming language such as
 **Java, C\+\+, Go, or Python** 
 .
* Strong analytical thinking and problem\-solving skills with a passion for building scalable software.
* Curiosity to learn, ownership, and the ability to thrive in a collaborative engineering environment.
* Internship, academic projects, or hands\-on experience in backend systems, distributed systems, cloud technologies, or AI/ML is a plus.



  





**Why Join ThoughtSpot?** 



* Work on cutting\-edge AI and distributed systems challenges at enterprise scale.
* Learn from experienced engineers through mentorship, code reviews, and collaborative design.
* Build products that power data\-driven decisions for global organizations.
* Grow in a culture that values innovation, ownership, and continuous learning.
* Make meaningful contributions from the very beginning of your career.



  





**In\-Office at ThoughtSpot** 




 Spotters are expected in\-office 3\+ days per week to be part of the energy of their local team. Momentum compounds when we're in the room together with faster decisions, sharper problem\-solving, and the kind of peer learning that doesn't happen over a screen. Being in\-office is our default way of working, with flexibility available where it's genuinely needed.
 



  





**About ThoughtSpot** 




 The world’s most innovative companies turn to ThoughtSpot’s AI\-Powered Analytics to put data in the hands of everyone, from the C\-suite to the frontline. With simple, natural language search and AI, anyone can ask questions, discover insights, and act with confidence. Unlike legacy tools that sacrifice performance for complexity, ThoughtSpot is intuitively designed for every business user while being built to handle the most complex, large\-scale data, wherever it resides. This unique combination of speed and simplicity is why enterprise leaders trust ThoughtSpot to transform decision\-making into a truly data\-driven culture.
 



 At ThoughtSpot, we’re a curious, data\-driven bunch. We believe the world works better when everyone has access to facts. That’s why we build products that make asking and answering data questions as natural as having a conversation.
 



**Mandatory And Required Skills For All ThoughtSpot Roles** 




 Spotters are expected to demonstrate AI literacy and workflow integration to include to ability to:
 


* Comfortably and confidently integrate artificial intelligence into their daily workflow to increase productivity and quality.
* Hands\-on experience to leverage AI tools (industry\-leading LLMs) to increase productivity, automate routine tasks, and improve work quality.
* Speak to the experience of using AI for research, content creation, and document summarization while maintaining ownership of judgment and final decisions.
* Write effective prompts to get the most accurate and creative results from AI tools.



 Spotters are expected to exemplify these key traits and AI Mindset:
 


* Curiosity in exploring new AI tools
* Adaptability to quickly learn and implement new, emerging AI technologies
* Critical thinking to know when to identify when AI should be used versus when human judgement is necessary



 This combination of curiosity, adaptability, and discernment defines the AI mindset, and it’s required for every role at ThoughtSpot.
 



  





**AI Mindset for All Spotters** 




 At ThoughtSpot, we believe AI is a necessary and essential part of how we work. Every role, across every team, is expected to be fluent and comfortable with using AI to do their best work.
 



 All Spotters are expected to experiment with ThoughtSpot’s AI tools (like Spotter and SpotterViz) and leading industry LLMs to streamline workflows, enhance output, and uncover new insights. Whether drafting content, analyzing data, or summarizing documents, AI is a daily partner. We value curiosity, openness to learning, and thoughtful application of AI to create real value. Training and resources are provided so every Spotter can confidently create with AI.
 



  





**ThoughtSpot for All** 




 At ThoughtSpot, diverse teams build better products. Complex data problems need many perspectives, not just one. We welcome different backgrounds, identities, and experiences, and we work to create a place where everyone can be themselves and do their best work. If this role excites you and you believe you’re a strong match, we encourage you to apply.
 



  





**What Makes ThoughtSpot a Great Place to Work?** 




 ThoughtSpot is the Agentic Analytics Platform that empowers every enterprise to transform insights into action, on a mission to make the world more fact driven. We hire people with unique identities, backgrounds, and perspectives \- this balance\-for\-the\-better philosophy is key to our success. When paired with our culture of Trust, Customer Obsession, Innovation and Intensity, ThoughtSpot cultivates a respectful culture that pushes norms to create world\-class products. If you’re excited by the opportunity to work with some of the brightest minds in the business and make your mark on a truly innovative company, we invite you to read more about our mission, and apply to the role that’s right for you.

description:

title: AI / Emerging Tech Security Analyst
description:
**About The Role**
 What if your security expertise could directly shape how the world's most powerful AI systems defend themselves against misuse, manipulation, and attack? We're looking for AI Security Analysts to stress\-test frontier models — probing their boundaries, identifying vulnerabilities, and helping ensure that cutting\-edge AI remains safe, reliable, and resistant to adversarial exploitation.
   

  

 This is a fully remote, flexible contract role built for security professionals who are curious about AI and want to work at the intersection of two of the most consequential fields in tech.
   

  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week


**What You'll Do**
* Analyze real\-world AI and LLM security scenarios to understand how models behave under adversarial or unexpected conditions
* Review and evaluate cases involving prompt injection, data leakage, model abuse, jailbreaking, and system misuse
* Classify security issues by real\-world impact and likelihood, and recommend appropriate mitigations
* Apply threat modeling frameworks to emerging AI technologies and deployment contexts
* Help evaluate and improve AI system behavior so it stays safe, aligned, and resilient against exploitation
* Work independently on task\-based assignments at your own pace


**Who You Are**
* Background in cybersecurity, information security, or a closely related field
* Solid understanding of modern threat modeling — and a genuine interest in how it applies to AI systems
* Analytical and precise when evaluating complex systems and potential attack surfaces
* Curious about how AI models are built, deployed, and potentially abused
* Comfortable working independently and communicating findings clearly in writing


**Nice to Have**
* Hands\-on experience with penetration testing, red teaming, or vulnerability research
* Familiarity with large language models, prompt engineering, or AI safety concepts
* Background in application security, API security, or cloud security
* Experience with security frameworks such as MITRE ATT\&CK or OWASP
* Prior involvement in bug bounty programs or responsible disclosure


**Why Join Us**
* Work directly on frontier AI systems alongside leading AI research labs
* Fully remote and flexible — work when and where it suits you
* Freelance autonomy with the structure of meaningful, impactful work
* Contribute to AI safety at a critical moment in the development of the technology
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

**Department:** Service \& Technical Operations

Job Summary

CorpCulture is looking for a **Service Engineer** responsible for installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, repair, and servicing of printers and related office equipment at customer locations. The engineer will also coordinate with the service team and maintain proper service records.

Key Responsibilities

* Visit customer locations for printer installation, service, maintenance, and troubleshooting.

Required Skills

* Good communication with customers.
* Willingness to travel to customer locations.
* Ability to work independently in the field.

* Proper documentation and service reporting.

Qualification \& Experience

description:
**Company Overview**
 Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1\.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business\-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the \#1 company in e\-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

 Docusign is seeking a Cyber Threat Intelligence Engineer to join our Threat Intelligence team. In this role, you will design, build, and maintain infrastructure, tools, and capabilities that enables the Threat Intelligence team to perform threat intelligence analysis and dissemination. You will create tools, automations, dashboards, data pipelines, and integrations that enable fast, scalable, and centralized access to threat intelligence data. The ideal candidate will have strong engineering skills and past experience in security operations.
   

  

 This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Senior Manager of the Threat Intelligence team.
   

  

**Responsibility**
* Architect, construct, and maintain robust infrastructure for collecting, processing, storing, and analyzing cyber threat intelligence data
* Implement engineering best practices to maximize data quality and operational visibility for threat analysis
* Develop and deploy scalable automation workflows to streamline threat intelligence operations
* Collaborate with analysts to translate operational requirements into high\-performing, reliable technical solutions
* Produce technical documentation, interactive dashboards, and key metrics to measure system performance and business impact


 Job Designation
   

  

**Hybrid:** 
 Employee divides their time between in\-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in\-office expectation)
   

  

 Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.
   

  

 What you bring
   

  

**Basic**
* 3\+ years of proven experience in cyber threat intelligence engineering, incident response, security automation, or data engineering
* Hands\-on experience leveraging Generative AI for security operations, including prompt definition, model benchmarking, and integrating scalable AI solutions into intelligence workflows
* Demonstrated ability to configure, deploy, and maintain threat intelligence platforms (TIPs) and integrate structured threat data into enterprise security tools
* Proficiency in creating and managing interactive Python notebooks (e.g., Jupyter, Marimo), configuring data connections, building reusable workflows, and documenting analytical processes
* Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience


**Preferred**
* Experience designing and operating cloud\-based data platforms, automation services, and infrastructure\-as\-code in AWS, Azure, or GCP
* Proficiency with Git\-based development practices, including branching, pull requests, code review, CI/CD, and automated testing
* Experience integrating threat intelligence platforms with enterprise security tools, including SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, vulnerability management, and case\-management systems
* Knowledge of threat intelligence standards and data technologies, including STIX/TAXII, MITRE ATT\&CK, Python, SQL, APIs, and relational, graph, or search databases
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to convey complex technical concepts clearly


 Life at Docusign

 Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. title: Territory Service Representative NHC 378414
description:
About DHL Blue Dart Express India:  

Blue Dart Express Limited, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.
Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.  

We are proud to be consistently ranked among India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an Employer of Choice is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.
If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, Blue Dart is where you belong. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.  

  

  

Position Overview:
The Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.
Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.  

Job Purpose:
To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.  

Key Roles \& Responsibilities:
Pickup \& Delivery Operations* Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.

  

Customer Service Excellence* Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.
* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.
* Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.
* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.

  

COD \& Documentation Management* Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.
* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.

  

Operational Compliance* Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

  

Safety \& Security* Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

  

Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility* Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

  

Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

  

Team Collaboration* Work closely with Shift In\-charges and branch operations teams.
* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.
* Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.
* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.

  

Qualifications \& Experience:
Education:* Minimum 8th Standard Pass.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

  

Experience:* Fresher or up to 2 years of relevant experience in courier, logistics, distribution, retail delivery or field operations.
* Experience in pickup and delivery operations will be an added advantage.

  

Eligibility Requirements:* Minimum age 18 years.
* Valid Two\-Wheeler or Four\-Wheeler Driving Licence.
* Must own a two\-wheeler where deployment requires the employee to use a personal vehicle, in accordance with Company policy.
* Physically fit to perform field operations.
* Willingness to work across shifts, weekends and holidays based on business requirements.

  

Skills \& Capabilities:  

Technical Skills:* Pickup \& Delivery Operations
* Shipment Handling
* Cash Collection (COD)
* Proof of Delivery (POD)
* Mobile Device / Scanner Usage
* Route Familiarity
* Basic Computer \& Mobile Application Skills
* Basic English Reading \& Understanding


Key Competencies:* Customer Focus
* Integrity
* Reliability
* Safety Consciousness
* Teamwork
* Discipline
* Time Management
* Accountability
* Positive Attitude
* Professional Appearance

  

Key Performance Indicators:  

KRAs KPIs
Delivery \& Pickup Performance On\-Time Delivery • Pickup Adherence • Delivery Productivity
Service Quality First Attempt Delivery • Shipment Handling Accuracy • Customer Satisfaction
COD \& Documentation COD Collection Accuracy • POD Completion • Zero Documentation Errors
Safety \& Compliance Safe Driving • SOP Adherence • Uniform \& Grooming Compliance
Operational Productivity Shipments Delivered/Picked Up • Scanner Compliance • Route Efficiency  

Why join DHL Blue Dart?
When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.
Here’s what makes us stand out:* Great Place to Work® Certified—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
* Competitive pay and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
* Structured learning, global exposure, and on\-the\-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
* Best\-in\-class benefits—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
* A culture that celebrates diversity, innovation, and bold thinking—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
* Global career paths across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220\+ countries and territories.
* The pride of working with India’s most awarded logistics brand, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.


This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. Come grow with us.

* Knowledge of **ONT/ONU, OLT, routers, switches, Wi\-Fi, and CPE**.
* Basic understanding of IP addressing, DHCP, DNS, VLAN, and network troubleshooting.

* Ability to identify and troubleshoot fiber cuts, optical power loss, and connectivity issues.

description:
HR EXECUTIVE — RECRUITMENT \& CANDIDATE COORDINATION

Experience: Fresher – 1 year

Salary: ₹20,000 – ₹40,000 per month (based on skill and experience)

Location: 515, Gera Imperium Rise, Opposite Wipro, Hinjewadi Phase 2, Pune

Type: Full\-time, on\-site

ABOUT US

We're hiring across almost every function at once right now — developers, designers, operations, security, content, social media — sometimes ten roles open at the same time. Right now, one person is running all of that screening alone.

THE ROLE

This role supports our HR function on the day\-to\-day recruitment grind — sending out screening questionnaires, following up with candidates, organising responses, and keeping every open role's pipeline moving instead of sitting in someone's inbox. If a good candidate goes cold because nobody followed up, that's this role's gap to close.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

\- Send our standard screening questionnaire to applicants — experience, current company, current and expected CTC, notice period, skills and years, projects, problem\-solving examples, resume and portfolio, best time to call

\- Follow up with candidates who haven't replied, politely and persistently, until you get a real answer

\- Organise every candidate's response and resume so the team can review them in minutes, not hours

\- Schedule interview calls and coordinate calendars between candidates and the hiring team

\- Keep a running, accurate tracker of every open role — how many applied, how many screened, how many scheduled, how many rejected and why

\- Draft and send candidate communication — screening messages, interview invites, rejections — professionally and on time

\- Post job openings across the platforms we use, and keep listings current as roles open and close

\- Support onboarding paperwork and documentation for candidates who get selected

\- Flag any pattern worth knowing — a role getting no real applicants, a question candidates keep struggling with

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

\- Fresher to 1 year — internships in HR or recruitment count

\- Clean, professional written English — you'll be messaging candidates directly, and it has to read right

\- Genuinely organised — juggling several open roles and dozens of candidates without losing track of any of them

\- Comfortable on the phone — calling and following up with candidates who haven't replied

\- Basic comfort with spreadsheets or a simple tracker tool

\- Reliable and consistent — candidates dropping through the cracks because of a missed follow\-up is not acceptable

\- A genuine interest in recruitment, not HR as a fallback choice

BONUS POINTS

\- HR\-related internship or coursework (BBA/MBA HR, certification, or similar)

\- Experience with any applicant tracking or recruitment tool

\- Comfortable screening technical or creative profiles, even without deep technical knowledge yourself

\- Bilingual — Hindi and English both

WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

\- Not a strategic HR or policy role — that sits above this one

\- Not a one\-role\-at\-a\-time job — several pipelines run in parallel, every day

\- Not a role where candidates wait a week for a reply — follow\-ups happen the same day

HOW TO APPLY

Send us:

1\. Resume

2\. Expected salary and notice period (or availability, if you're a fresher)

3\. A 3\-4 line note on why recruitment/HR specifically interests you

Applications without the note will not be reviewed.

Mail to: hr@dhanode.com

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month
