title: Data Center Technician, Data Center Operations (DCO)
description:
**Description**
 AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
   

  

 You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is growing rapidly, and we are looking for Data Center Technician to join our expanding Infrastructure Operations team.
   

  

 Data Center Operations designs, installs and maintains the world’s largest Computing Infrastructure. Our scope of work includes systems, repairing, dealing with issues, handling and tracking parts and assisting in Data Center maintenance. Amazon Data Centers are large\-scale high\-density centers where you will help change the face of Technology in the region.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 As Data Centre Operations Engineer, you will be the primary point of contact for internal customers. There is never a dull moment as each day presents itself with different challenges. Some of the key responsibilities you will undertake are:
   

  

* You will troubleshoot technical issues on advanced hardware, ranging from servers, storage and networking devices on a 24/7 basis.
* You will maintain a high level of system reliability and availability.
* You will participate in projects to enhance operational efficiencies with opportunities to share experiences and knowledge with our global network of technical experts.
* You will share knowledge and help train less technical staff on the best practices related to all service owner issues
* You will contribute towards building a great team by getting involved in the Amazon hiring process/candidate interviews


 A day in the life
   

  

 As a successful Data Center Operations engineer, your day\-to\-day work will include:
   

  

* Installation and configurations on Data center Servers and Network systems
* Installation, troubleshooting and replacement of internal and external hardware parts of Servers and Network devices
* Work within a ticket\-based environment and work on systematic problem resolution
* Work on rotational shift\-based schedule to maintain high system reliability
* Collaborate with internal teams and share ideas and contribute in innovative projects to improve DC work environment and overall efficiencies.
* This is a physically active role, we are always on the move onsite.


**About The Team**
 About AWS
   

  

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field
* Experience with computer hardware troubleshooting and repair


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Can work in cramped spaces or in elevated locations while adhering to health \& safety guidelines
* Experience dealing effectively with customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure
* Experience managing work and priorities through a ticketing system
* Experience with cabling infrastructure best practices and methodologies
* Experience working in a data center environment (racking and stacking gear, cable management, hot/cold aisle containment)


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

 As a Networking Managed Services Engineer (L1\) at NTT DATA, you'll step into an entry\-level role where your primary focus will be providing managed services to ensure our clients' IT infrastructure and systems remain operational. Your day will involve proactively identifying, investigating, and resolving technical incidents and problems to support our clients effectively.

Your role may occasionally extend to supporting project work and disaster recovery functions and tests, contributing to our broader goals and ensuring we're always ahead of the curve.

* Basic understanding in technologies such as Pulse Secure SSL VPN, Virtual Juniper, Palo Alto, Fortinet Firewalls, Cisco Nexus switches, ASr and ISr routers, Cisco ACS, ISE, Meraki switches, and common routing protocols like BGP, OSPF, and EIGrP.
* Highly disciplined in handling of tickets on day\-to\-day basis. Act promptly as per defined Sop’s.
* Try to resolve as many tickets as possible using available Knowledge articles or provided Sop’s.
* Good understanding of using ITSM tools and ITSM processes.
* Strong planning skills, considering possible changes and circumstances.
* A strong work ethic, including the capacity to put in longer hours when necessary.
* Adaptability to changing environments.
* A client\-focused approach, creating positive client experiences throughout their journey.

 Babylonia is a controlled\-environment agriculture company based in Kozhikode. We build living walls, indoor farming systems, and the software that runs them. Small team, real products.

 Apply here, or write to careers@babylonia.ag with a link to an app you have built and its Play Store or App Store listing if it is live.

title: Unity Look-Dev Artist
description:
**Job Title:** 
 Unity Look\-Dev Artist.
 



**Department:** 
 Immersive Technologies
 



**Location:** 
 Vapi, Gujarat
 



**Reports To:** 
 XR Lead
 



**Experience:** 
 4–6 Years
 



**Job Purpose:** 




 To own the in\-engine look development of immersive surgical training modules by assembling 3D assets, configuring materials, lighting, environments, post\-processing, cameras, and training UI within Unity. The role will ensure that art assets are correctly integrated, visually consistent, performance\-optimized, and delivered as development\-ready Unity scenes for implementation by Unity developers and simulation engineers.
 



**Key Responsibilities:** 




**1\. Unity Look Development \& Scene Creation** 




 • Build, configure, and maintain Unity scenes for immersive surgical training modules.
 



 • Assemble 3D environments, surgical instruments, robotic components, anatomical assets, and supporting elements into production\-ready scenes.
 



 • Configure scene hierarchy, prefabs, transforms, cameras, lighting, materials, and environmental settings.
 



 • Establish reusable Unity scene templates and master configurations for different training modules.
 



 • Maintain visual consistency across multiple simulation modules and environments.
 



**2\. Lighting \& Environment Development** 




 • Design and implement realistic lighting setups for operating\-room and surgical training environments.
 



 • Create and maintain master lighting rigs suitable for different training scenarios.
 



 • Configure real\-time and baked lighting workflows based on project requirements.
 



 • Optimize lighting quality while maintaining target workstation GPU performance.
 



 • Evaluate scenes under different camera positions, viewpoints, and training conditions.
 



 • Ensure adequate visual clarity for surgical instruments, anatomy, UI elements, and critical training information.
 



**3\. Materials \& Rendering Setup** 




 • Import and configure materials and textures produced by 3D Texturing and Look\-Dev teams.
 



 • Validate PBR materials, shaders, normal maps, smoothness/roughness, metallic, AO, and other texture channels within Unity.
 



 • Configure material properties to achieve the required visual quality and physical appearance.
 



 • Identify and resolve material, shader, texture, and rendering issues during asset integration.
 



 • Support the development and maintenance of standardized material and rendering workflows.
 



**4\. Asset Integration \& Art\-to\-Engine Pipeline** 




 • Import and configure models, textures, animations, prefabs, and other art assets within Unity.
 



 • Identify and correct common integration issues related to scale, orientation, pivots, transforms, hierarchy, materials, and asset settings.
 



 • Ensure assets comply with established art\-to\-engine standards before integration into training modules.
 



 • Maintain proper prefab and scene discipline for efficient development and future updates.
 



 • Coordinate with 3D Modeling, Sculpting, Texturing, and Technical Art teams to resolve asset\-related issues.
 



**5\. Training UI \& HUD Implementation** 




 • Design and implement training\-oriented UI layouts within Unity.
 



 • Create and configure:
 


* Training HUDs
* Menus
* Instruction panels
* On\-screen guidance
* Labels and indicators
* Progress and status elements
* Basic interaction interfaces
* • Ensure UI is visually consistent with the overall simulator experience.
* • Ensure instructional UI remains readable and accessible at relevant training distances and screen resolutions.
* • Work with UX/UI designers and Unity developers to implement approved UI designs.
* • Maintain reusable UI prefabs and layout components where required.



**6\. Scene Performance \& GPU Optimization** 




 • Profile Unity scenes to identify GPU and rendering performance bottlenecks.
 



 • Optimize lighting, materials, textures, shaders, post\-processing, draw calls, and scene complexity.
 



 • Work within defined workstation GPU and memory budgets.
 



 • Collaborate with Technical Artists, Unity Developers, and Simulation Engineers to resolve performance issues.
 



 • Balance visual fidelity with real\-time performance requirements without compromising critical training elements.
 



**7\. Post\-Processing \& Visual Effects** 




 • Configure appropriate post\-processing effects for immersive surgical environments.
 



 • Tune exposure, color grading, ambient effects, bloom, depth\-related effects, and other approved visual treatments where applicable.
 



 • Ensure post\-processing supports visual clarity and realism without negatively affecting performance.
 



 • Maintain consistent visual treatment across different training modules.
 



**8\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 




 • Work closely with:
 


* XR / Simulation Lead
* Unity Developers
* Technical Artists
* 3D Modelers
* Sculpting Artists
* Texturing Artists
* UI/UX Designers
* Simulation Engineers
* Clinical SMEs
* • Participate in art pipeline reviews, scene reviews, and development planning meetings.
* • Communicate technical dependencies, integration issues, and performance concerns proactively.
* • Incorporate artistic, technical, clinical, and usability feedback into scene development.



**9\. Dev\-Ready Scene Quality \& Handoff** 




 • Establish and enforce an art\-to\-engine handoff checklist for every training module.
 



 • Conduct quality checks before scenes are handed over to Unity developers for module implementation.
 



 • Verify:
 


* Asset scale and orientation
* Prefab structure
* Scene hierarchy
* Materials and textures
* Lighting
* Cameras
* UI layout
* Performance
* Naming conventions
* Asset dependencies
* • Sign off scenes as development\-ready once defined quality and performance requirements are met.
* • Maintain quality standards without unnecessarily delaying development delivery.



**10\. Version Control \& Documentation** 




 • Maintain Unity scenes, prefabs, materials, UI assets, and related files using Git/Git LFS or the approved version\-control workflow.
 



 • Follow project naming conventions, folder structures, scene organization, and asset management standards.
 



 • Document scene configurations, lighting setups, performance considerations, and known dependencies where required.
 



 • Ensure changes are traceable and maintainable throughout the project lifecycle.
 



**11\. Innovation \& Continuous Improvement** 




 • Explore new Unity rendering, lighting, shader, UI, and look\-development techniques.
 



 • Contribute to improving the visual quality and performance of the surgical training simulator.
 



 • Stay updated with developments in Unity, real\-time rendering, technical art, XR/VR/AR, serious games, and simulation.
 



 • Develop reusable scene templates, lighting rigs, materials, prefabs, and workflows to improve production efficiency.
 



**Qualifications and Experience:** 




 • Diploma / Bachelor’s degree / equivalent qualification in Game Art, 3D Design, Animation, Computer Graphics, Multimedia, Visual Effects, or a related field.
 



 • 4–6 years of professional experience in
 **Unity Look Development, Technical Art, Environment Art, or real\-time 3D production** 
 .
 



 • Strong professional experience working with Unity.
 



 • Deep experience in at least one Unity rendering pipeline:
 **URP or HDRP** 
 .
 



 • Strong understanding of real\-time lighting, materials, rendering, scene management, and optimization.
 



 • Experience implementing UI within Unity.
 



 • Experience with prefab, scene, hierarchy, and asset management workflows.
 



 • Experience working within a multi\-disciplinary art and engineering pipeline.

**2\. Channel\-Packed Texture \& Technical Art Workflows** 




 • Create and maintain channel\-packed textures to optimize GPU memory and material performance.
 



 • Implement project\-specific packing standards such as:
 


* R \= Metallic
* G \= Ambient Occlusion
* A \= Smoothness
* • Ensure gloss/smoothness and roughness maps are correctly converted and exported according to the defined Unity pipeline.
* • Validate packed textures for accuracy, consistency, and compatibility with Unity materials.

**4\. UV Mapping \& Texel Density Management** 




 • Create and optimize UV layouts using Maya, Blender, or equivalent tools.

description:
**Company Description** 




 Cosmoserve Space is dedicated to building a cleaner, more sustainable future for space exploration through advanced active debris removal technologies. The company’s mission is to safeguard the orbital environment with high\-tech, cost\-effective solutions that address the growing challenge of space debris. Cosmoserve Space combines cutting\-edge engineering with a market\-leading approach to responsible space operations. Team members collaborate in a passionate, expert\-driven environment that values innovation, reliability, and long\-term impact. The organization is focused on ensuring that space remains accessible and safe for current and future missions.
 



  





**Role Description** 





 Cosmoserve Space is looking for a
 
 Computer Vision Engineer who is working on perception systems for spacecraft and space\-object relative navigation. He/She will design and build algorithms that estimate the 6\-DoF (position and orientation) of non\-cooperative or known space objects for autonomous rendezvous, proximity operations, and docking. This role sits at the intersection of classical computer vision (detection, geometry, calibration) and modern deep learning, with heavy use of synthetic data generated in simulation environments.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 · Building vision\-based relative navigation pipelines for object detection, instance/semantic segmentation, and pose estimation of rigid space objects.
 



 · Working with PnP algrithms and RANSAC, epipolar geometry, and homography\-based pose recovery techniques, along with feature descriptors such as SIFT, ORB, etc
 



 · Applying data augmentation and domain randomization strategies to close the sim\-to\-real gap across illumination, albedo, distance, and attitude variations.
 



 · Handling classical image processing tasks, including filtering, morphological operations, and edge/contour and blob detection, alongside learned features.
 



 · Generating and curating photorealistic synthetic datasets in Blender, using procedural scenes, domain randomization, and automated ground\-truth pose/segmentation export.
 



 · Working across stereo and monocular camera geometry, including depth estimation, triangulation, and multi\-view sensor fusion.
 



 · Managing camera calibration workflows, including intrinsic/extrinsic parameters, lens distortion modeling, and stereo rectification, for single and multi\-camera rigs.
 



 · Optimizing and deploying models on embedded platforms such as NVIDIA Jetson, using TensorRT, ONNX, and CUDA for real\-time inference, including profiling and quantization.
 



 · Collaborating with GNC (Guidance, Navigation \& Control) and simulation teams to feed pose and uncertainty estimates into the navigation filter.
 



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 




 · 2\+ years of relevant industry or research experience with a master’s degree, or 4\+ years of relevant industry or research experience, in Computer Vision, Robotics, Computer Science, or a related field.
 



 · Strong foundation in computer vision and deep learning: CNN backbones, detection architectures, segmentation architectures, pose estimation networks.
 



 · Solid grasp of projective geometry: PnP with RANSAC and Experience in applying data augmentation and domain randomization for robust, generalizable models.
 



 · Strong command of classical image processing using OpenCV (filtering, morphology, feature extraction, edge/contour detection).
 



 · Working knowledge of stereo and monocular camera geometry, depth estimation, and rectification.
 



 · Proficiency in Python, PyTorch, OpenCV, and NumPy, with hands\-on experience in model training, evaluation, and profiling.
 



  





**Nice to Have** 




 · Hands\-on
 **camera calibration** 
 experience (single or multi\-camera, intrinsic/extrinsic).
 



 · Prior exposure to spacecraft navigation, robotics perception, or similar safety\-critical vision applications.
 



 · Familiarity with sensor fusion and state estimation (e.g., Kalman filtering) in a navigation context.

**Description**
 Amazon’s global fulfilment network enables any merchant in any of the geography ship items that you order on Amazon, to any place on earth. Amazon Logistics’ (AMZL) delivery stations (DS) receive packages from Fulfilment Centers (FCs) and Sort Centers (SCs) and sort them to route level. Drivers come into the DS and pick up the packages for their route and deliver them to Amazon’s customers. This operation is also called the “Last Mile”. An integral component in the Last Mile ecosystem are Amazon's WW delivery hubs where packages are received, sorted and prepared for on\-road delivery. Station Tech team, in Last Mile, is responsible for building scalable tools and technology for delivery hubs that scale across multiple programs and businesses including Amazon Logistics (AMZL), Global Specialty Fulfilment (GSF), to increase associate productivity, site throughput, and operational quality and scalability of our delivery network. Our primary customers are delivery station associates (our actual on\-ground rockstars who sort millions of packages a day), station managers (who manage Amazon hubs WW to ensure customer promises are met), COs (central operations team who supervise stations across regions) and on\-road delivery agents (drivers who sail through all obstacles to get your packages at your doorstep). The team build tools and process which guide our customers to reduce their cognitive load, eliminate decision points to drive standardisation, prioritise work to focus on the highest impact tasks, and take steps for correcting operational defects to reduce the impact of human error and meet our customer SLAs.
   

  

 UTR Tech is an organisation within Last Mile supporting all the delivery stations in the delivery network. A delivery station receives an input set of packages from upstream and performs the required set of operations and processes on the packages to ultimately get them out of the delivery stations for on\-road delivery. The associates within the delivery stations use a mobile based application called Dolphin for running the execution operations. Node Receive COD team handles the process of receiving packages, routing them back to right origin, and handling Cash on delivery reconciliations and liabilities among driver, station and bank.

 As an SDE\-2, you will develop a deep understanding of our business, work closely with development teams and own the architecture and end\-to\-end delivery of software components. title: Mechanical Engineer - Internship
description:
**About Airbound**
------------------

**Our mission is to make a world where everyone has access to delivery. Where goods move as freely as information moves today.**


This is possible. Today the cost of moving on a scooter is ₹2/km. That’s the cost of moving a 150kg mass from point A to B. We’re bringing that mass down to less than 5kgs, concurrently bringing the cost down to 10 paise/km. This is how we make deliveries a reality. This is how we create a world where we’re doing billions of deliveries per day.


The tech is not there. The current cost of drone delivery is ₹100/km. We need to completely redefine the way things are done here. We’re building the world’s most efficient aircraft from the ground\-up, and scaling that up to beyond anything the aerospace sector has ever seen. This cannot be an iterative process. We have to tear down all conventions and build everything up from scratch.


To do this, we need nothing less than the best engineers. The ones who care about building something fundamentally different, who are deeply curious about understanding the fundamentals of everything they’re working on, who are dreamers that believe in the impossible.

**About Hardware Engineering**
------------------------------


Hardware Engineering owns the aircraft's physical development, from a concept sketch to a part that flies. This spans system design, mechanism design, and structural design: working out how something moves, what it's made of, and whether it holds up under real load. Because most of what we design is custom, it also means designing the equipment we use to prove our work — rigs, jigs, and testers built specifically to validate a design before it goes anywhere near a real flight. It's one team across concept, design, initial prototyping, and test: the full arc of getting a product from an idea to something that ships.

**About the Role**
------------------


We're hiring a Mechanical Engineering Intern \- for freshers and university students who've built things with their own hands, not just studied how to. No prior professional experience is required; what we're looking for instead is real, hands\-on project experience: BAJA, FSAE, robotics teams, personal builds, or similar.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Mechanism \& Assembly Design**

* Support the design and development of mechanisms and mechanical assemblies for our aircraft, from early concept through production intent
* Build and test prototypes yourself — this is a hands\-on role, not a design\-and\-hand\-off one

**Analysis \& Validation**

* Assist with load calculations, tolerance stacks, basic FEA, and weight budgets to validate designs before they're cut or molded

**Manufacturing Process Exposure**

* Work with composites layup, injection molding, additive manufacturing, and CNC machining to learn how to choose the right process for each part

**Composites \& Structures Track**

* If focused on composites/structures: help us model and design composite structures — laminate design, layup optimization, and structural analysis — rather than just building to a fixed layup

**Mechanism Design Track**

* If focused on mechanism design help select actuation hardware — servos, stepper motors, and similar — and write short scripts to drive and test them

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Must\-Have**
--------------

* Currently pursuing, or recently completed, a degree in mechanical engineering or a related field
* Real hands\-on project experience (BAJA, FSAE, robotics, or similar build teams) that demonstrates genuine mechanism design or composites/structures work, not just coursework
* Working familiarity with 2D and 3D CAD
* Basic understanding of load calculations, tolerance analysis, and weight budgeting
* Strength in at least one of the following:


	+ Detailed mechanism design (including actuation hardware selection and basic scripting to drive and test it)
	+ Composites and structures (modeling and analysis, not just layup execution)
* Strong attention to detail and a willingness to get hands\-on with hardware
* Clear communicator, comfortable working with both internal teams and external vendors
* Willingness to go the extra mile when a project needs it

**Work location:** Hoskote, Bangalore (Headquarters)

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* **Comprehensive health insurance** to keep you and your loved ones covered
* **Relocation assistance and a daily travel stipend** to ease your commute
* **Advanced salary credit** to support you when you need it


“A driven, passionate team where you’ll have room to grow and thrive \- **this is more than just a job, it’s a rare opportunity to build something meaningful** from the ground up”

------------------

description:
**Job Title:** 




 R\&D Officer – Surgical Robotics
 



**Department:** 




 Research \& Development – Surgical Robotics
 



**Location:** 




 Vapi, Gujarat / Field\-based (as per requirement)
 



**Reports To:** 




 R\&D Manager – Surgical Robotics
 



  





**Job Purpose:** 




 To support the design, development, testing, and clinical validation of surgical robotic systems and advanced medical devices by assisting R\&D activities and conducting field\-based clinical data collection, usability validation, and deployment support in hospital environments.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**1\. Product Development \& R\&D Support** 




 • Assist in the design, development, and validation of surgical robotic systems and related medical devices.
 



 • Support prototype evaluation, system testing, and performance validation activities under guidance of senior engineers.
 



 • Participate in product improvement initiatives focusing on functionality, safety, usability, and clinical effectiveness.
 



**2\. Clinical \& Field Activities** 




 • Conduct frequent field visits to hospitals and clinical sites for:
 



 • Anatomical and procedural data collection
 



 • System testing and usability validation
 



 • Clinical workflow observation and feedback collection
 



 • Supporting device deployment and technical troubleshooting
 



 • Assist during live clinical procedures and trials to understand surgical workflows and device performance.
 



**3\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 




 • Work closely with R\&D, Clinical, Regulatory, Quality, and Manufacturing teams to support cross\-functional projects.
 



 • Coordinate with surgeons, clinicians, and hospital staff for clinical evaluations and data validation.
 



 • Support regulatory and quality activities by providing clinical and technical inputs during product development.
 



**4\. Documentation \& Compliance** 




 • Document clinical observations, field visit findings, test results, and validation data as per internal SOPs.
 



 • Prepare technical reports, study summaries, and improvement recommendations.
 



 • Ensure compliance with internal quality standards, clinical protocols, and regulatory guidelines during field activities.
 



**5\. Innovation \& Learning** 




 • Contribute to innovation initiatives in surgical robotics, automation, and advanced healthcare technologies.
 



 • Continuously upgrade technical and clinical knowledge through hands\-on exposure and mentoring.
 



 • Support early\-stage research activities and feasibility studies for new product concepts.
 



  





**Qualifications and Experience:** 




 • Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Biomedical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or Electronics \& Communication Engineering (ECE).
 



 • Fresh graduates or candidates with up to 1 year of relevant academic / internship exposure.
 



 • Exposure to clinical environments, medical device projects, or hospital\-based internships is preferred.
 



  





**Skills and Competencies:** 




 • Fundamental understanding of human anatomy (mandatory).
 



 • Strong interest in medical devices, surgical robotics, and healthcare technologies.
 



 • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
 



 • Strong observation, documentation, and analytical skills.
 



 • Ability to work collaboratively in a team\-oriented, multidisciplinary environment.
 



 • Willingness to travel frequently to hospitals and clinical sites across locations.
 



  





**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):** 




 • Quality and accuracy of clinical and field data collected
 



 • Timely completion of assigned R\&D and validation activities
 



 • Quality of technical documentation and reports
 



 • Effectiveness of clinical feedback and usability insights shared
 



 • Contribution to product development milestones and innovation initiatives

title: Senior Travel Consultant
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION  
Company: Book My Tour Now

**Website:** www.bookmytournow.com  
**Job Title:** Travel Consultant  
**Department:** Sales \& Travel Consulting  
**Location:** Sector 48,Gurugram, Haryana  
**Reports To:** Sales Manager / Team Leader

About Book My Tour Now

**Book My Tour Now** is a customer\-focused Tours \& Travels company providing customized travel packages and travel\-related services for domestic and international customers.

We focus on understanding each customer's travel requirements, creating suitable travel solutions, managing bookings efficiently, and providing support throughout the travel planning process.

Our goal is to deliver a smooth and reliable customer experience through **personalized travel solutions, timely communication, organized booking processes, and strong coordination between Sales and Operations teams.**

Job Summary

The **Travel Consultant** will be responsible for handling customer travel inquiries, understanding their requirements, preparing customized travel packages and quotations, following up with prospective customers, and converting inquiries into confirmed bookings.

The role involves managing the customer journey from the **initial inquiry through quotation, follow\-up, booking, payment, confirmation, and handover to the Operations Team.**

The Travel Consultant will also be responsible for maintaining accurate customer and follow\-up information in the CRM, coordinating internally for booking execution, and ensuring timely and professional communication with customers.

This position plays an important role in **lead conversion, sales growth, customer satisfaction, and smooth booking coordination.**

Key Duties \& Responsibilities1\. Lead Management \& Customer Contact

* Manage assigned leads and initiate customer contact according to the daily sales plan.
* Respond to customer inquiries through phone, WhatsApp, email, and other approved communication channels.
* Understand the customer's travel plans, preferences, budget, and expectations.
* Maintain regular and disciplined follow\-ups until the inquiry is closed.

2\. Understanding Customer Requirements

Collect and understand important travel requirements, including:

* Destination
* Departure city
* Travel dates
* Number of passengers
* Number and type of rooms
* Hotel category
* Trip duration
* Inclusions and exclusions
* Sightseeing requirements
* Transportation requirements
* Flight requirements
* Food preferences
* Special requests
* Approximate travel budget

3\. Travel Package Preparation

* Prepare customized travel packages based on customer requirements.
* Select suitable existing packages or create customized packages when required.
* Review itinerary details, hotels, transportation, sightseeing, flights, and other travel services.
* Ensure that package details are accurate and aligned with customer requirements.

4\. Quotation Preparation \& Presentation

* Prepare accurate quotations based on available costing and approved pricing.
* Review day\-wise itineraries, hotel details, flight information, inclusions, exclusions, and pricing before sharing quotations.
* Share quotations with customers through email, WhatsApp, or other approved channels.
* Explain package details, pricing, inclusions, exclusions, terms, and conditions clearly to customers.
* Make approved changes to quotations based on customer feedback.

5\. Customer Follow\-Up \& Sales Conversion

* Follow up with customers at mutually agreed times.
* Understand customer feedback and address questions or concerns.
* Revise packages and quotations where appropriate.
* Maintain accurate follow\-up dates and customer responses in the CRM.
* Work consistently toward converting qualified inquiries into confirmed bookings.
* Maintain professional communication throughout the sales process.

6\. Booking \& Payment Coordination

* Confirm booking requirements with customers before proceeding.
* Collect required customer information and documents.
* Generate and share payment links through approved payment platforms.
* Guide customers through the payment process when required.
* Record full or partial payments accurately.
* Ensure customer and transaction information is updated correctly in the CRM and relevant systems.

7\. Sales \& Operations Coordination

* Coordinate with the Operations Team for:
* Flight availability and booking
* Hotel availability and confirmation
* Sightseeing
* Transfers
* Transportation
* Costing
* Guest details
* Special requests
* Final booking confirmations
* Ensure all relevant customer information is properly handed over to the Operations Team.
* Follow up internally to ensure timely execution of confirmed bookings.

8\. Booking Documentation \& Customer Communication

* Share booking confirmations, tickets, invoices, payment details, vouchers, and other required documents with customers.
* Ensure customer\-facing documents are accurate before sharing.
* Maintain complete and updated customer records.
* Ensure all relevant communication and booking information is properly documented in the CRM.

9\. CRM \& Record Management

* Maintain accurate lead, customer, quotation, follow\-up, booking, and payment information in the CRM.
* Update lead status and follow\-up activities on a timely basis.
* Record customer requirements, discussions, quotation changes, and important commitments.
* Ensure no important customer information or follow\-up activity is missed.

Qualifications \& Experience

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
* Freshers with strong communication skills and a willingness to learn are encouraged to apply.
* Experience in **Tours \& Travels, Travel Sales, Travel Consulting, Customer Service, Hospitality, or a related field** will be an advantage.
* Basic understanding of domestic and international travel processes is preferred.
* Candidates with experience handling customer inquiries, sales calls, quotations, and follow\-ups will be preferred.

Skills \& Abilities

The candidate should possess:

* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong customer\-handling and relationship\-building skills.
* Good sales and follow\-up discipline.
* Ability to understand customer travel requirements.
* Ability to prepare and explain travel packages and quotations.
* Good negotiation and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to handle multiple customer inquiries simultaneously.
* Good time\-management and organizational skills.
* Basic computer and documentation skills.
* Attention to detail while entering customer, booking, and payment information.
* Professional attitude and customer\-focused approach.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively with Sales and Operations teams.
* Willingness to learn new destinations, travel products, packages, and company processes.
* Ability to work toward sales targets and business objectives.

Tools \& Technology

The Travel Consultant will regularly work with:

* CRM / Lead Management System
* Razorpay or similar payment platform
* Zoho Email
* WhatsApp
* MS Excel
* MS Word
* Email and Internet Applications
* Travel package and quotation systems used by the company

**CRM discipline is an important part of this role.** The employee is expected to maintain accurate and timely records of customer requirements, follow\-ups, quotations, bookings, payments, and other relevant activities.

Work Environment

Book My Tour Now provides a **professional, supportive, customer\-focused, and growth\-oriented work environment.**

The Travel Consultant will work closely with the **Sales and Operations teams** and will have regular interaction with customers.

The role encourages:

* Continuous learning
* Teamwork
* Professional customer service
* Disciplined follow\-up
* Sales performance
* Attention to detail
* Ownership of assigned leads
* Effective coordination between departments

Benefits \& Growth Opportunities

* Training and learning opportunities in the travel industry.
* Practical exposure to domestic and international travel packages.
* Opportunity to develop sales and customer\-handling skills.
* Career growth opportunities based on performance.
* Supportive and collaborative team environment.
* Exposure to customized travel planning and booking processes.
* Performance\-based growth opportunities.
* Opportunity to develop knowledge of destinations, hotels, flights, sightseeing, transfers, and travel products.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate should be **customer\-focused, energetic, disciplined, professional, and willing to learn.**

They should enjoy interacting with customers, understanding their travel requirements, creating suitable travel solutions, preparing quotations, and following up consistently until booking closure.

The candidate should be comfortable handling multiple inquiries, maintaining accurate CRM records, coordinating with internal teams, and working toward sales targets.

A successful Travel Consultant at Book My Tour Now should demonstrate:

* Strong communication
* Customer\-centric approach
* Sales orientation
* Consistent follow\-up
* Attention to detail
* Good organization
* Problem\-solving ability
* Professional behavior
* Teamwork
* Willingness to learn
* Ownership and accountability

Key Performance Areas

Performance in this role may be evaluated based on:

* Lead response and contact discipline
* Number and quality of customer follow\-ups
* Quotation turnaround time
* Lead\-to\-booking conversion
* Sales performance
* Customer communication and service quality
* Accuracy of CRM records
* Booking and payment documentation accuracy
* Coordination with Operations
* Customer satisfaction
* Achievement of assigned sales targets

Role Objective

**To convert qualified travel inquiries into confirmed bookings by providing customized travel solutions, professional customer service, timely follow\-ups, accurate quotations, and seamless coordination with the Operations Team.**

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

**Location:** Delhi / Gurugram


**Type:** Full\-time


**Experience:** 3–8 years


**Industry Preference:** NBFC / MSME Lending / SME Lending / Financial Services


**Role Overview**
-----------------


We are looking for a Senior Relationship Manager with strong experience in NBFC/MSME lending or investment sales, along with the ability to understand and analyze financial statements.


The candidate will be responsible for sourcing and developing relationships with MSME/SME businesses, identifying lending and investment opportunities, understanding business requirements, conducting preliminary financial analysis, and managing the relationship through the transaction lifecycle.


### **Key Responsibilities**


#### **1\. Business Development \& Sales**


* Source new MSME/SME lending and investment opportunities through direct sourcing, referrals, CA networks, DSAs, financial advisors, and industry contacts.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with SME/MSME promoters, business owners, and CXOs.
* Identify businesses that meet the lending/investment requirements of the assigned business or entity.
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective clients and opportunities.
* Achieve assigned business development, sourcing, and revenue targets.

#### **2\. Relationship Management**


* Manage relationships with existing and prospective MSME/SME clients.
* Understand the client's business model, financial requirements, funding needs, and growth plans.
* Act as the primary point of contact and ensure smooth coordination throughout the transaction process.
* Develop long\-term relationships with promoters, referral partners, and other stakeholders.

#### **3\. Financial Analysis \& Initial Assessment**


* Analyze P\&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow statements of prospective businesses.
* Understand profitability, leverage, liquidity, working capital, and cash\-flow position.
* Conduct preliminary assessment of the company's financial strength and repayment/investment capacity.
* Review financial information and identify key business and financial risks.
* Coordinate with the Credit/Risk/Investment teams for detailed evaluation and underwriting.

#### **4\. Deal Execution \& Coordination**


* Coordinate with internal teams including Credit, Risk, Finance, Legal, Operations, and Compliance.
* Support the transaction process from sourcing and initial evaluation through sanction/investment and disbursement, wherever applicable.
* Ensure timely collection of financial and business documents from clients.
* Support structuring of suitable lending/investment solutions based on business requirements.

#### **5\. Portfolio \& Relationship Monitoring**


* Maintain regular engagement with clients and monitor business performance.
* Track repayment/business performance and identify potential concerns or early warning signals.
* Support repeat business and cross\-selling opportunities.
* Maintain accurate records and MIS of business sourced and relationships managed.

### **Ideal Candidate**


* 3–8 years of relevant experience in NBFC, MSME/SME lending, business banking, or financial services.
* Strong experience in MSME lending or investment sales.
* Existing network among MSME/SME promoters, CAs, DSAs, financial advisors, and business networks will be an advantage.
* Ability to understand and analyze financial statements and business performance.
* Good understanding of credit, lending, and financial products.
* Strong relationship management, communication, negotiation, and sales skills.
* Ability to balance business development with financial/business assessment.
* MBA Finance / CA / CFA or equivalent qualification will be an advantage.
### **Not Suitable**


* Pure retail loan sales profiles.
* Candidates with only retail lending experience.
* Pure sales profiles without understanding of financial statements.
* Freshers or candidates without relevant NBFC/SME/MSME experience.
### **What We Offer**


* Opportunity to work with a growing financial services group.
* Exposure to MSME lending, investments, and multiple businesses within the Company.
* Direct interaction with business owners and senior management.
* Growth\-oriented role with business development and financial analysis exposure.
* Competitive compensation and performance\-based incentives.
### **Important Note**


The selected candidate may be aligned with any specific business, vertical, subsidiary, associate, or entity within the Company based on organizational requirements.


The candidate may also be employed on the payroll of Company. or any other entity within the Company, as determined by management and business requirements.

 And there's one thing we care about beyond the usual PM toolkit : You should genuinely love fashion.
   

  

 You notice what people are wearing. You know when a trend is taking off. You have opinions on how people discover brands, put together looks and decide what to buy.
   

  

 You don't just work on fashion. You talk about it. You follow it. You wear it.
   

  

**What You'll Build**
 You'll work on 0 \- 1 bets for Nykaa Fashion across areas such as :
   

  

* New Discovery Experiences : Rethink how shoppers discover fashion beyond traditional homepages, PLPs and search \- from visual and inspiration\-led discovery to new content\-led shopping formats.
* AI x Fashion : Explore how Generative AI can change fashion shopping \- styling, personalization, conversational shopping, visual discovery and completely new interfaces.
* Content x Commerce : Build experiences where reels, creators, UGC, trends and editorial content become native parts of the shopping journey.


**What You'll Do**
* Build 0 \- 1 : Take ambiguous ideas from customer problems \- hypothesis \- prototype \- MVP \- experiment \- scale.
* Think customer\-first : Spend time understanding how people actually discover, evaluate and buy fashion \- not just what funnel dashboards tell us.
* Experiment aggressively : Run rapid experiments, learn what works and be equally comfortable scaling a winner or killing an idea.
* Use AI as a product primitive : Prototype with LLMs, multimodal models and emerging AI capabilities rather than treating AI as an add\-on.
* Own outcomes : Define clear customer and business metrics and take accountability for impact, not feature launches.
* Work deeply with Design \& Engineering : Build alongside designers and engineers from day one rather than throwing requirements over the fence.
* Stay culturally curious : Track fashion, creators, Gen Z behaviour, global commerce products and emerging consumer experiences \- and translate those signals into product ideas.


**Who We're Looking For**
 2 \- 4 years of Product Management experience, preferably in consumer internet or e\-commerce.
   

  

**You Will Probably Thrive Here If**
* You've shipped meaningful consumer products and can demonstrate measurable impact.
* You're comfortable operating with ambiguity and limited precedent.
* You have strong product intuition but are equally comfortable getting into data.
* You understand experimentation, funnels and consumer behaviour.
* You can work effectively with Design, Engineering, Analytics and Business teams.
* You're naturally curious about AI and how it changes consumer products.
* You move fast, prototype before over\-specifying, and learn from real users.
* Prior e\-commerce, discovery, personalization, content, social commerce or AI product experience is a strong plus.


 And the biggest plus? You are a fashion enthusiast. Not because your resume says Fashion / E\-commerce. Because you genuinely have a point of view on fashion. You follow brands, creators and trends. You understand why someone saves a look on Instagram, searches for it on Google, asks a friend about it and eventually buys something completely different.
   

  

 We want someone who can bring that instinct into the products they build.
   

  

**Why Nykaa Fashion? :**
 Because fashion e\-commerce still has a lot left to reinvent.
   

  

 Most shopping experiences today are built around catalogues, filters and funnels. The next generation will increasingly be built around inspiration, identity, creators, personalization and AI.
   

  

 At Nykaa Fashion, you'll get the scale of a major consumer platform with the opportunity to operate like a small 0 \- 1 product team. Millions of shoppers. Thousands of brands. And plenty of unsolved problems.
   

  

 Come build what fashion shopping looks like next!

description:
Job Description
**Designation:** Diploma Engineer Trainee (DET) – Civil
  

**Department:** Project Execution / Civil
  

**Location:** EPC Project Site
  

**Reporting To:** Site Engineer / Project Manager / Construction Manager


### **Job Purpose**


To support the site civil execution team in carrying out construction activities as per approved drawings, specifications, quality standards, safety requirements, and project schedules.


### **Key Responsibilities**


* Assist Site Engineers in execution and supervision of **civil construction activities** at the project site.
* Study and understand approved **civil drawings, BOQ, specifications, and method statements**.
* Support activities such as:
	+ Excavation and earthwork
	+ PCC/RCC works
	+ Reinforcement and shuttering
	+ Foundation and structural works
	+ Masonry and plastering
	+ Road, drainage and flooring works
	+ Equipment foundations and related civil works
* Monitor day\-to\-day site activities and ensure execution as per approved drawings and instructions.
* Assist in checking **line, level, alignment, dimensions, and quantity** of executed work.
* Coordinate with subcontractors, labour teams, surveyors, QA/QC, safety, planning, and stores teams.
* Maintain daily records of **manpower, materials, work progress, and site activities**.
* Assist in preparation of **Daily Progress Reports (DPR)** and other project documentation.
* Support measurement of completed work for **BOQ and subcontractor billing**.
* Ensure proper utilization and availability of construction materials at site.
* Coordinate with the QA/QC team for inspections and required quality checks.
* Follow approved **ITP, method statements, safety procedures, and quality standards**.
* Report construction issues, drawing discrepancies, material shortages, and site constraints to the reporting engineer.
* Ensure proper housekeeping and compliance with project **HSE requirements**.
* Participate in site meetings and provide updates regarding assigned activities.
* Assist in maintaining as\-built records and other relevant site documentation.
* Perform any other civil/project\-related responsibilities assigned by the Project Manager or reporting authority.

### **Required Technical Skills**


* Diploma in **Civil Engineering** from a recognized institute.
* Basic knowledge of civil construction and EPC project execution.
* Ability to read and understand **civil drawings and BOQ**.
* Basic knowledge of AutoCAD.
* Understanding of measurements and quantity calculations.
* Basic knowledge of RCC, reinforcement, shuttering, concrete, earthwork, and finishing works.
* Basic knowledge of construction quality and safety practices.
* MS Office knowledge, particularly **Excel and Word**.

### **Behavioral Competencies**


* Willingness to work at project/site locations.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Strong learning attitude and ability to work under supervision.
* Teamwork and discipline.
* Problem\-solving approach.
* Ability to manage site activities and priorities.
* Attention to detail.
* Commitment to quality, safety, and project timelines.

### **Key Performance Areas (KPAs)**


* Timely execution of assigned civil activities.


* Compliance with approved drawings and specifications.


* Quality of construction work.


* Productivity and effective utilization of manpower/materials.


* Timely reporting and documentation.


* Coordination with site departments and subcontractors.


* Compliance with HSE requirements.


* Achievement of assigned project milestones.


**Experience:** Freshers / 0–2 years of relevant site experience.
  

**Qualification:** Diploma – Civil Engineering.
  

**Job Nature:** Full\-time \| Site\-based EPC Project.

title: Scrum Master
description:
Join us as a Scrum Master at Barclays where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting\-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.
   

  

 To be successful as a Scrum Master, you should have experience with:
   

  

  

* Agile Delivery \& Ceremonies.
* Facilitate and time‑box all Scrum ceremonies: Sprint Planning, Daily Stand‑ups, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives.
* Ensure ceremonies are value‑driven, outcome‑focused, and aligned to MCP ways of working.
* Support teams in defining Sprint Goals, managing commitments, and avoiding spill‑overs.
* Ensure user stories have clear acceptance criteria, are estimated with team consent, and follow Agile best practices.
* Coach teams on Agile and Scrum principles, fostering ownership, accountability, and self‑organisation.
* Create a psychologically safe environment that enables honest reflection and continuous improvement.
* Identify and remove impediments and blockers to maintain delivery momentum.
* Promote strong Agile hygiene including Jira updates, correct status/labels, and transparent reporting.
* Act as a bridge between delivery teams and Product Owners, Tech Leads, Architects, Release/Integration teams, and other Scrum Masters.
* Proactively manage cross‑team dependencies, risks, and delivery constraints.
* Represent the team in MCP forums (e.g. design reviews, sprint demos, governance touchpoints).
* Escalate risks and issues with clear context and data‑backed insights.
* Track and report delivery health using Agile metrics (e.g. sprint predictability, carry‑over, team capacity).
* Support compliance with Barclays governance, risk, and control expectations.
* Ensure transparency on delivery progress, risks, and outcomes.
* Contribute to Quarterly / PI objectives and Scrum Master OKRs for MCP teams.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* Proven experience as a Scrum Master in complex technology delivery environments.
* Strong understanding of Scrum, Agile, and Lean principles.
* Scrum certification (CSM, PSM, SAFe SSM).
* SAFe or large‑scale Agile exposure.
* Experience working with cross‑functional engineering teams (Dev, QA, Architecture).
* Hands‑on experience with Jira / Agile tooling.
* Strong facilitation, coaching, and conflict‑resolution skills.
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders across business and technology.


 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 The role is based out of Pune.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 Facilitates and supports Agile teams by ensuring they follow Scrum principles. To remove obstacles, enhance team collaboration, and ensure smooth communication, enabling the team to focus on delivering high\-quality, iterative results. Facilitate Scrum events, promote continuous improvement, and act as a bridge between the team and external stakeholders.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Facilitate Events: Facilitate events, as needed, and ensure that all events take place and are positive, productive, and kept within the timebox
* Support Iteration Execution: Ensure quality of ceremony artefacts and continuous customer value through iteration execution, maintain backlog refinement, and iterate on stakeholder feedback
* Optimize Flow: Identify and facilitate the removal of conflict impacting team flow, utilizing metrics to empower the team to communicate effectively, making all work visible
* Mitigate Risks: Identify and escalate risks to remove impediments and shield the Squad from interruptions
* Build High\-Performing Teams: Foster and coach Agile Team attributes and continuous improvement, encourage stakeholder collaboration, deputise ‘in the moment leadership’, and drive high\-performing team attributes
* Stakeholder Management: Facilitate stakeholder collaboration (e.g., business stakeholders, product teams, vendors) and build trust with stakeholders
* Governance and Reporting: Ensure data quality and provide representation at required governance forums, if applicable


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
 To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
   

  

 Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
   

  

 If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
   

  

 OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
   

  

 Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
   

  

 Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
   

  

 Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
   

  

 Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
   

  

 Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
   

  

 Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
   

  

 Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
   

  

 Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.
   

  

 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

 We're looking for a Product Designer to help shape the day\-to\-day experience of TIST Media's platform \- translating product thinking into clean, considered interfaces our users actually enjoy using. This is a craft \- heavy role for a designer who is past the "figuring out the basics" stage and ready to take real ownership of features, partner closely with engineers, and grow into a senior seat over time. title: Sr Officer R&D Electronics
description:
**Job Title:** 
 Sr. Officer – R\&D – Electronics.
 



**Location:** 
 Vapi, Gujarat
 



**Reports To:** 
 R\&D Lead
 



**Experience:** 
 2–3 Years
 



  





**Job Purpose** 




 To support the design, development, integration, testing, and validation of electronic medical devices for the portfolio.
 



 The role will focus on electronics hardware, embedded firmware, sensors, physiological signal acquisition, communication interfaces, hardware\-software integration, prototyping, troubleshooting, and product verification.
 



 The position requires a hands\-on R\&D engineer capable of converting product requirements into reliable electronic solutions while working within applicable medical\-device quality, safety, regulatory, and documentation requirements.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Medical Electronics Product Development** 



* Participate in the complete R\&D lifecycle covering concept, feasibility, prototyping, development, integration, verification, validation, and product release.
* Support development of electronic systems for:
* Rigid \& Portable Colposcope
* Electronic Fetal Monitor
* Fetal Doppler Monitor
* Telemetry\-Based Fetal Monitoring System
* Smart Fetal Monitor
* Other medical\-device platforms
* Translate product and system requirements into suitable electronic and embedded solutions.
* Support component selection, prototyping, system integration, testing, debugging, and design improvements.
* Work closely with senior R\&D engineers and cross\-functional teams to deliver reliable, clinically relevant products.



**2\. Electronics Hardware Development** 



* Design, modify, test, and troubleshoot analog and digital electronic circuits.
* Work with:
* Microcontrollers/processors
* Sensors and transducers
* ADC/DAC
* Amplifiers and filters
* Signal\-conditioning circuits
* Power and battery\-management systems
* Displays and LEDs
* Communication modules
* Support schematic development, PCB design/review, BOM preparation, component selection, prototype assembly, and board bring\-up.
* Evaluate components based on performance, reliability, availability, cost, and product requirements.
* Troubleshoot hardware failures through structured Root Cause Analysis (RCA).



**3\. Embedded Firmware \& Hardware\-Software Integration** 



* Develop, modify, test, and integrate embedded firmware using C/C\+\+ and relevant microcontroller platforms.
* Develop and debug drivers and interfaces for sensors, displays, communication modules, memory, ADC/DAC and other peripherals.
* Support device control logic, data acquisition, alarms, monitoring, communication, and device\-status management.
* Perform hardware\-firmware integration and troubleshoot interface\-level issues.
* Use appropriate IDEs, programmers, debuggers, logic analyzers, and other development tools.
* Maintain source code using appropriate version\-control practices.



**4\. Physiological Signal Acquisition \& Fetal Monitoring** 



* Support development of electronic systems for fetal and maternal physiological monitoring.
* Work with signals/technologies such as:
* Fetal Heart Rate (FHR)
* Doppler\-based fetal monitoring
* Maternal heart rate
* TOCO / uterine activity
* ECG and other physiological signals
* Support signal acquisition, amplification, filtering, sampling, ADC conversion, noise reduction, and signal conditioning.
* Investigate signal\-quality issues including noise, interference, artifacts, instability, and signal integrity.
* Support integration of sensors and physiological signals with embedded processing and user interfaces.



**5\. Fetal Doppler, Wireless \& Telemetry Systems** 



* Support electronics development for Fetal Doppler and telemetry\-based monitoring systems.
* Work with Doppler transducers, signal\-acquisition electronics, amplification, filtering, and embedded processing.
* Support integration of Bluetooth/BLE, Wi\-Fi, RF/wireless telemetry, and other communication technologies.
* Troubleshoot connectivity, communication stability, latency, range, packet loss, synchronization, and interference issues.
* Participate in wireless module integration and system\-level testing.



**6\. Colposcope \& Imaging Electronics** 



* Support electronic development and integration for Rigid and Portable Colposcope systems.
* Work with:
* Camera/image sensors
* LED illumination
* Displays
* Image\-acquisition systems
* Electronic/optical interfaces
* Power and control electronics
* Support camera and sensor integration with embedded systems.
* Troubleshoot image quality, illumination, electronic noise, connectivity, and performance issues.
* Collaborate with optical, mechanical, software, and clinical teams.



**7\. Prototyping, Debugging \& Laboratory Testing** 



* Build and test electronic prototypes and proof\-of\-concept systems.
* Perform PCB bring\-up, power\-up, interface verification, subsystem testing, and system integration.
* Use laboratory equipment such as:
* Digital Multimeter
* Oscilloscope
* Logic Analyzer
* Function Generator
* DC Power Supply
* Electronic Load
* Spectrum/RF equipment, where applicable
* Perform component\-level and system\-level troubleshooting.
* Conduct structured RCA and corrective design improvements.
* Document technical observations, failures, corrective actions, and test results.



**8\. Verification, Validation \& Product Testing** 



* Develop and execute engineering test plans, test cases, protocols, and reports.
* Support:
* Design Verification
* Design Validation
* Functional Testing
* Performance Testing
* Electrical Safety Testing
* Environmental/Reliability Testing
* Regression Testing
* Identify, document, and resolve defects.
* Verify hardware and firmware changes before product release.
* Support pre\-compliance and product qualification activities.



**9\. Medical Device Quality \& Regulatory Compliance** 



* Follow established medical\-device development and quality processes.
* Support engineering documentation and compliance activities in coordination with Quality and Regulatory teams.
* Maintain awareness/exposure to:
* IEC 60601 – Medical Electrical Equipment
* IEC 62304 – Medical Device Software
* ISO 13485 – Quality Management Systems
* ISO 14971 – Risk Management
* Applicable EMC and electrical\-safety requirements
* Applicable CE, FDA and Indian regulatory requirements
* Support risk analysis, FMEA, hazard identification, risk controls, and design\-change documentation.



**10\. Engineering Documentation \& Design Transfer** 



* Prepare and maintain:
* Schematics
* PCB documentation
* BOMs
* Component specifications
* Interface specifications
* Test specifications
* Technical reports
* Maintain revision\-controlled hardware and firmware documentation.
* Support component lifecycle management and alternate component identification.
* Support design transfer, pilot production, manufacturing troubleshooting, calibration, test fixtures, and End\-of\-Line testing.
* Support DFM/DFT initiatives for production\-ready designs.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 




**Education** 




 Bachelor's degree in:
 


* Electronics \& Communication Engineering
* Electronics Engineering
* Electrical \& Electronics Engineering
* Instrumentation Engineering
* Biomedical Engineering
* Or a related engineering discipline



**Experience** 



* 2–3 years of relevant experience in:
* Electronics R\&D
* Embedded Systems
* Medical Electronics
* Medical Devices
* Healthcare Technology
* Product Development
* Hands\-on experience in electronics hardware and hardware\-software integration.
* Experience with microcontrollers, embedded systems, PCB/schematic development, debugging, and electronic testing.
* Experience with C/C\+\+ or equivalent embedded programming languages.
* Medical\-device industry experience will be strongly preferred.



  





**Technical Skills** 




**Electronics \& Embedded** 



* Strong understanding of analog and digital electronics
* Microcontrollers and embedded systems
* Sensors and transducers
* ADC/DAC
* Amplifiers and filters
* Signal conditioning
* Power and battery management
* PCB and schematic design
* Hardware debugging and bring\-up



**Communication Interfaces** 




 Working knowledge of:
 



 UART \| SPI \| I²C \| USB \| CAN \| Bluetooth/BLE \| Wi\-Fi \| RF/Wireless
 



**Firmware** 



* C/C\+\+
* Microcontroller programming
* Peripheral interfacing
* Device drivers
* Debugging and firmware integration
* Version control



  





**Key Competencies** 



* Strong analytical and problem\-solving ability
* Hands\-on approach to electronics development and troubleshooting
* Good understanding of hardware\-firmware integration
* Strong RCA and debugging capability
* Ability to read schematics and component datasheets
* Understanding of physiological signals and medical sensors
* Good technical documentation skills
* Attention to detail and product quality
* Ability to work effectively in a cross\-functional R\&D environment
* Ability to work in a regulated medical\-device development environment
* Curiosity to learn new technologies and solve complex engineering problems
* Passion for
 **medical technology, electronics, embedded systems, and healthcare innovation**



  





**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** 




  





**R\&D Delivery** 




 Timely completion of assigned R\&D activities and engineering milestones
 



**Hardware Development** 




 Quality, reliability and performance of electronic prototypes/designs
 



**Integration** 




 Successful hardware\-firmware\-sensor\-system integration
 



**Signal Quality** 




 Accuracy and reliability of physiological signal acquisition
 



**Debugging** 




 Timely resolution of technical issues through structured RCA
 



**Testing** 




 Successful completion of verification, validation and engineering testing
 



**Quality \& Compliance** 




 Adherence to medical\-device development and documentation processes
 



**Documentation** 




 Accuracy and completeness of schematics, BOMs, test reports and technical records
 



**Manufacturing Transfer** 




 Successful transition of validated designs to production
 



**Design Improvement** 




 Reduction in failures and improvement in reliability, performance and cost
 



**Innovation** 




 Contribution of new technologies, ideas and design improvements

By building a platform that can fly frequently, recover gently, and serve a wide range of commercial and defence needs, we’re opening doors to a space\-powered industrial future. As an Admin \& HR Associate, you will own the company’s day\-to\-day administration and HR operations, ensuring the smooth functioning of the office, employee lifecycle, compliance, documentation, facilities, and internal execution. You will proactively coordinate across teams, follow up on deliverables, enforce organizational processes, and ensure day\-to\-day operations run efficiently and seamlessly.

This role requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work across multiple functions while maintaining structure and accountability.
