title: Senior Systems Support Executive - IT Infrastructure
description:
**Roles \& Responsibilities**  
**1\. IT Infrastructure Management**

* Troubleshoot minor and major hardware breakdowns and ensure \>95% uptime by providing immediate rectification support — self or through external vendors for repair / replacement.
* Manage (installation, configuration, and support) all network devices, cloud servers, physical servers, software licenses, software databases, security solutions (anti\-virus, etc.), and other business software / subscriptions on various computers, Cloud Systems (AWS), and laptops with \>95% uptime, including Data Backup and Production Backup.
* Install, configure, and monitor system hardware, software, and networks on a routine basis to ensure optimal performance and application of security patch updates.
* Monitor system performance, capacity, and availability — proactively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks; prepare setup for VAPT (Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing).
* Evaluate and procure hardware servers, computers, laptops, peripheral devices, security automation tools / gadgets, etc. on behalf of the company with due approval on cost.
* Evaluate and procure software solutions, licenses, domains from registrars, and subscriptions on behalf of the company.
* Extend support for on\-site email installation and remote email server management / rectification.
* Management and maintenance of Data Backup and Restoration checks for on premise and cloud systems as per defined policy / process.
* Management of company's data and voice communication systems in liaison with AMC Partner / UPS / Cables.
* Manage physical positioning and inventory of computers, laptops, peripherals, and software — maintain an accurate and up\-to\-date Asset Inventory at all times.
* Timely submissions of internal reports, Subscription Renewal tracking and timely submission of CSP Evaluation with required details to the Reporting Head.
* Update all relevant trackers on a daily basis; raise CRF requests; perform Incident Reporting and timely escalation to the Reporting Head.

**2\. Information Security Posture \& Standards Management** 

* Own and maintain APT's Information Security posture across the organization in accordance with ISO 27001:2022 (ISMS) standards — as the designated custodian within APT.
* Document system configurations, procedures, and troubleshooting steps — ensuring accurate and up\-to\-date documentation including Knowledge Base (KB), Trackers, Asset Inventory, and all components of the Network Diagram, as per the ISO process.
* Remediate OS and other security vulnerabilities on a proactive basis; apply security patches and updates within defined TATs; maintain a Vulnerability Register.
* Implement and enforce APT's Information Security Policy across all staff — covering data handling, access controls, acceptable use, and password management.
* Formulate and maintain IT Audit Checklists; undertake periodic technical audit checks of hardware, software, and network infrastructure; report findings to Reporting Head.
* Sensitize company staff on cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and best security practices for data management — conduct ISMS Awareness / InfoSec Awareness sessions for all staff including new joinees and freshers.
* Coordinate with external IT auditors, ISO consultants, and certification bodies during ISMS audits, surveillance audits, and renewal audits — compile and submit required evidence, records, and documentation.
* Maintain and update the Risk Register, Business Continuity Plan (BCP), and Disaster Recovery (DR) documentation as per ISO 27001 requirements.
* Ensure access control management — provisioning, modification, and de\-provisioning of system access for all employees, including joiners, transfers, and leavers — within defined TATs.
* Monitor and report on key Information Security metrics / KPIs to the Reporting Head on a periodic basis.

**3\. Team Support \& Knowledge Management** 

* Provide training and documented Knowledge Base (KB) to junior team members and new joiners — covering IT Infra processes, ISMS sessions, and systems orientation.
* Advice the Reporting Head on best management practices for internal systems infrastructure and information security posture.
* Provide weekend / extended support in cases of critical infrastructure incidents or security events.
* Carry out multitasking and prioritization of tasks effectively to meet deadlines — or as directed by the Reporting Head.

**Qualification / Skill\-sets**

* B.Sc. / B.Sc. (IT) / B.E. / B.Tech. / BCA / Computer Diploma / Technical Graduate or equivalent qualification.
* Minimum 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in Systems, Hardware, Network, and Information Security Management.
* In\-depth knowledge of installing, configuring, and maintaining various hardware and network devices — network switches, access points, routers, firewalls, printers, scanners, etc. is a pre requisite.
* In\-depth knowledge of installing and maintaining various OS and SQL / Oracle databases is a pre\-requisite.
* In\-depth knowledge of Windows Server environments (2012–2022\), DNS, Active Directory, Domain Control, IIS, and Group Policy is a pre\-requisite.
* Working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS / Azure / GCP) — cloud server management, cloud backup, and cloud security configurations.
* Sound knowledge and practical experience of ISO 27001:2022 (ISMS) — implementation, internal auditing, and documentation is a strong requirement.
* Hands\-on experience with VAPT tools and vulnerability management is an added advantage.
* Sound skills of hardware / software troubleshooting and root\-cause diagnosis.
* Excellent analytical ability and on\-the\-spot thinking — ability to work effectively under pressure and resolve incidents within TATs.
* Basic computer skills, including professional email writing are a must.
* Sound communication, inter\-personal, and documentation skills.

**Added Advantage Qualification / Skill\-sets**

* ITIL Management Certification is a strong added advantage.
* Advanced knowledge of network communication, VLAN management, and network security architecture.
* Advanced knowledge of Server Management — Physical, Virtual (Hyper\-V / VMware), Cloud Server Management, and Email Server Management.
* Prior experience of managing IT infrastructure for 75–100 computers / laptops along with network devices simultaneously.
* Experience in coordinating BCP / DR drills and preparing DR runbooks.
* Familiarity with SIEM tools, endpoint security platforms, and DLP solutions.

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

title: Research & Data Operations Associate – Real Estate and Global Markets
description:
Work Arrangement

* Office\-based during the first 2 weeks
* Hybrid work may be allowed thereafter, subject to accuracy, reliability and performance
* Up to 4 work\-from\-home days per week after successful onboarding

Schedule

* Monday to Friday
* 10:00 AM–6:00 PM
* Occasional Saturday work from home may be required when mutually agreed

About NITARYA

NITARYA is building a research\-led advisory platform for global property ownership, second homes and international living decisions.

Our Library contains structured information about countries, provinces, cities, localities, property markets, developers and individual projects. This information supports internal research, public evaluations and client advisory reports.

Role Overview

We are looking for a methodical and dependable person who can research different markets, verify information, enter it into predefined templates and maintain the accuracy of our Library.

This is not a basic data\-entry role. The person must be able to locate credible sources, identify missing or conflicting information and record findings clearly. The role also involves obtaining updated inventory and project information from brokers, developers and other partners.

Key Responsibilities

* Research countries, states or provinces, cities, towns, villages and localities.
* Research individual real estate projects, developers and ownership structures.
* Collect information using standard templates provided by NITARYA.
* Use government websites, regulatory authorities, credible research reports and other reliable sources.
* Record source links, publication dates and evidence for important information.
* Upload and organise approved information in the NITARYA Library.
* Check entries for accuracy, completeness, duplication and formatting errors.
* Identify information that is outdated, inconsistent or unsupported.
* Conduct manual verification whenever automated or AI\-generated information is uncertain.
* Contact brokers and developers through email, WhatsApp or calls to obtain updated inventory, pricing, availability and project documents.
* Maintain inventory trackers and follow\-up records.
* Assist with creating and reviewing research\-based reports.
* Report system errors, missing fields or workflow problems noticed while using the platform.
* Maintain confidentiality and follow NITARYA’s research and data\-handling standards.

Required Skills

* Strong online research and information\-verification ability.
* Good written English and reading comprehension.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.
* Ability to organise large amounts of information systematically.
* Attention to detail and patience with repetitive accuracy checks.
* Confidence in following up with brokers, developers and external partners.
* Ability to distinguish verified facts from marketing claims or assumptions.
* Comfort using AI tools for research assistance while independently verifying the output.
* Ability to work responsibly with limited supervision after training.

Educational Background

A bachelor’s degree in any relevant field, including:

* Economics
* Geography
* Business or Commerce
* Real Estate
* Urban Planning
* Finance
* Journalism
* Data or Information Management

Exceptional fresh graduates with strong research and communication skills may also apply.

Experience

* 0–2 years of relevant experience
* Experience in market research, real estate, data operations, due diligence or research\-based content is preferred
* Freshers may apply if they can demonstrate strong research ability

This Role Is Suitable for Someone Who

* Enjoys investigating and organising information.
* Questions unsupported claims rather than copying them.
* Can follow detailed templates without changing the prescribed structure.
* Is comfortable performing both research and operational follow\-ups.
* Takes ownership of accuracy and completes work on time.
* Wants to learn about international property markets and global living.

This Role May Not Suit Someone Who

* Treats research as copying information from the first Google result.
* Depends entirely on AI\-generated answers without checking sources.
* Dislikes structured templates, detailed checking or follow\-ups.
* Requires continuous supervision for routine work.
* Is looking for a sales\-only or property\-brokerage role.

Probation

Three months

Continuation and hybrid\-work eligibility will depend on research accuracy, reliability, productivity and adherence to processes.

Selection Process

* Application screening
* Short introductory interview
* Brief research and data\-entry assessment
* Final discussion

The assessment will test source selection, information verification, clarity and attention to detail.

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Work from home

Application Question(s):

* Are you able to work from our Pitampura office during the initial 2\-week training period?
* How many years of experience do you have in research, data operations or real estate?
* Are you comfortable contacting/calling brokers and developers across different countries for information and follow\-ups?
* What is your current monthly salary?

About Devprayagjal

Devprayagjal is a growing spiritual products brand serving customers across India. We are looking for a responsible and proactive **Order Management \& Customer Support Executive** to manage customer communication and ensure smooth order delivery.

Job Description

The candidate will be responsible for handling customer follow\-ups from the time an order is received until it is successfully delivered.

Key Responsibilities

* Call customers to **confirm orders and verify delivery addresses**.
* Confirm product details, order value, and customer's availability to receive the parcel.
* Follow up with customers who do not answer calls.
* Communicate with customers through **phone calls and WhatsApp**.
* Monitor orders and shipment statuses regularly.
* Follow up on **Undelivered, NDR and Delivery Attempted** orders.
* Contact customers to check whether the delivery executive actually called or visited.
* Coordinate with customers for genuine re\-delivery attempts.
* Identify and handle cases of **false/incorrect delivery attempts**.
* Raise complaints with **Shiprocket** when a genuine delivery attempt has not been made.
* Send emails and make calls to Shiprocket/customer support for delivery\-related issues.
* Follow up with Shiprocket until the issue is resolved.
* Proactively follow up on orders at risk of **RTO (Return to Origin)**.
* Maintain proper records of customer calls, order status, NDRs and follow\-ups.
* Ensure that no important customer or delivery follow\-up is missed.

Requirements

* Good communication skills in **Hindi**.
* Basic English communication skills.
* Comfortable making customer calls throughout the day.
* Basic knowledge of **WhatsApp, Email and Excel/Google Sheets**.
* Good follow\-up and organizational skills.
* Patient and polite while dealing with customers.
* Ability to handle multiple orders and follow\-ups.
* Responsible and willing to take ownership of tasks until they are completed.

Experience

Candidates with experience in **customer support, telecalling, e\-commerce, order management, logistics or delivery coordination** will be preferred.

**Freshers with good communication skills are also welcome to apply.**

What We Are Looking For

We need someone who doesn't just make calls but **takes ownership of the order until it is delivered**.

The ideal candidate should be proactive, responsible, comfortable with regular follow\-ups, and capable of coordinating effectively with both customers and logistics teams.

Key Performance Areas

* Order confirmation
* Address verification
* Customer follow\-up
* Successful delivery
* NDR resolution
* RTO prevention
* Delivery issue resolution
* Accurate order tracking and reporting

**ABOUT 3WHEELS.AI**

3Wheels.AI is an AI\-focused technology company delivering solutions across **Artificial Intelligence, Data, Automation, and Software Technologies**. We work with businesses globally to help them leverage technology, improve operational efficiency, and develop intelligent business solutions.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

We are looking for a **Pre\-Sales Executive** to support our **global business development and lead\-generation efforts**.

The candidate will primarily focus on identifying and reaching out to **AI companies, AI startups, SaaS companies, software companies, and technology businesses across global markets**.

The role involves researching potential clients, identifying key decision\-makers, initiating professional conversations through **LinkedIn, email, calls, and other B2B channels**, understanding initial requirements, and generating qualified business opportunities for 3Wheels.AI.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Research and identify potential **AI and technology companies globally**.
* Identify relevant decision\-makers such as **Founders, CEOs, CTOs, Product Heads, and Business Heads**.
* Conduct professional outreach through **LinkedIn, email, cold calls, and other B2B platforms**.
* Create personalized and professional email and LinkedIn outreach campaigns.
* Introduce 3Wheels.AI and communicate our AI and technology capabilities to prospective clients.

\# Social Media \& Content Manager / Founder’s Office Executive

\*\*Location:\*\* Cuttack, Odisha

\*\*Job Type:\*\* Full\-time \| On\-site

\*\*Experience:\*\* 1–3 years preferred

\*\*Industry:\*\* Education / Preschool / Parenting / Personal Brand

\#\# About the Role

We are looking for a \*\*creative, proactive, organised and digitally savvy Social Media \& Content Manager / Founder’s Office Executive\*\* to take ownership of the day\-to\-day digital presence of our school, parenting initiatives and associated platforms.

This is an \*\*in\-house role working closely with the Founder.\*\*

The selected candidate will be responsible for planning, coordinating, creating, publishing and monitoring content across \*\*Instagram, Facebook and YouTube\*\*, while also managing the online community, collaborations and digital growth initiatives.

The role will also involve \*\*Personal Assistant / Founder’s Office responsibilities\*\*, including coordination, scheduling, follow\-ups and day\-to\-day assistance to the Founder.

The candidate will have support from \*\*internal team members for shoots, content production and other execution requirements\*\*, but will be expected to take ownership of the planning, coordination, quality and timely execution of the overall digital function.

\-\-\-

\#\# Key Responsibilities

\#\#\# 1\. Social Media Management

\* Manage the day\-to\-day social media presence across:

\* Instagram

\* Facebook

\* YouTube

\* Other relevant digital platforms

\* Develop and maintain a \*\*monthly and weekly content calendar\*\*.

\* Plan content around school activities, events, festivals, education, parenting, children, community initiatives and campaigns.

\* Create and schedule posts, Reels, Stories, short\-form videos and other relevant content.

\* Write or coordinate captions, hooks, descriptions and basic social media copy.

\* Ensure consistency in brand voice, visual identity and communication.

\* Stay updated with social media trends, formats, features and content opportunities.

\#\#\# 2\. Content Creation \& Video Production

\* Plan and coordinate regular \*\*in\-house shoots\*\*.

\* Identify what content needs to be captured and when.

\* Shoot basic photos and videos using smartphones/cameras.

\* Coordinate with teachers, staff and the internal content team during shoots.

\* Have basic knowledge of lighting, framing, audio and video\-making.

\* Create or coordinate short\-form videos and Reels.

\* Have basic knowledge of video editing tools such as \*\*CapCut, VN, Canva, InShot, Premiere Pro or similar platforms\*\*.

\* Be comfortable working with basic equipment such as tripod, lights, microphones and mobile shooting accessories.

\* Coordinate with external professionals whenever specialised production is required.

\*\*Note:\*\* The candidate will not be expected to do everything alone. Internal team members will be available to support content shoots and execution. The candidate will be responsible for \*\*planning, directing, coordinating and ensuring completion.\*\*

\#\#\# 3\. YouTube Management

\* Assist in planning and managing the YouTube channel.

\* Develop ideas for long\-form and short\-form video content.

\* Coordinate video shoots and uploads.

\* Write basic titles, descriptions and other supporting content.

\* Understand the fundamentals of YouTube Shorts, thumbnails, titles, retention and engagement.

\* Monitor channel performance and recommend improvements.

\#\#\# 4\. Community Management

\* Monitor and respond to comments, messages and DMs across platforms.

\* Engage with parents, followers and the wider community.

\* Identify important questions, concerns, feedback and opportunities.

\* Maintain a positive and professional online presence.

\* Encourage meaningful conversations and community engagement.

\* Track relevant inquiries and leads generated through social media.

\#\#\# 5\. Collaborations \& Digital Growth

\* Identify relevant influencers, creators, educators, parenting communities and potential collaborators.

\* Research and propose suitable collaboration opportunities.

\* Coordinate with collaborators and manage communication/follow\-ups.

\* Monitor relevant trends and opportunities for the school and Founder.

\* Suggest new content formats and campaigns to improve reach and engagement.

\* Explore opportunities for cross\-promotion and community building.

\#\#\# 6\. Analytics, Reporting \& Performance

A key responsibility of this role will be \*\*monitoring performance and providing clear reporting.\*\*

The candidate will:

\* Track reach, views, engagement, follower growth and other relevant metrics.

\* Identify high\-performing and low\-performing content.

\* Understand basic social media analytics.

\* Provide \*\*weekly performance updates\*\*.

\* Prepare a \*\*monthly social media performance report\*\*.

\* Recommend what should be continued, changed or stopped based on data.

\* Maintain a clear record of content published, performance and upcoming plans.

We are looking for someone who understands that \*\*social media is not just about posting — it is about measuring, learning and improving.\*\*

\-\-\-

\#\# 7\. Founder’s Office / Personal Assistant Responsibilities

The candidate will work closely with the Founder and will also assist with selected professional and personal\-assistant responsibilities.

These may include:

\* Managing and coordinating the Founder’s calendar.

\* Scheduling meetings, calls and appointments.

\* Coordinating shoots, events and engagements.

\* Following up with team members, vendors, collaborators and external contacts.

\* Maintaining task lists and ensuring timely follow\-ups.

\* Coordinating information between the Founder and internal teams.

\* Assisting with day\-to\-day communication and organisation.

\* Helping ensure important commitments, deadlines and follow\-ups are not missed.

\-\-\-

\# Who Are We Looking For?

We are looking for someone who is:

\* \*\*Creative and curious\*\*

\* Proactive and takes initiative

\* Highly organised and good at follow\-ups

\* Comfortable working directly with a Founder

\* Social\-media savvy and aware of current trends

\* Comfortable with both \*\*content creation and coordination\*\*

\* Good at communicating with people

\* Willing to learn and experiment

\* Able to manage multiple priorities

\* Responsible, trustworthy and discreet

\* Comfortable working in a fast\-moving environment

\* Someone who looks at a problem and thinks \*\*"How can I solve this?"\*\* rather than waiting for instructions

\#\# Required Skills

\*\*Essential:\*\*

\* Good understanding of Instagram and Facebook

\* Basic understanding of YouTube and YouTube Shorts

\* Basic video\-making and shooting skills

\* Basic video editing skills

\* Familiarity with Canva and/or basic design tools

\* Understanding of Reels, Stories and short\-form content

\* Basic knowledge of social media analytics

\* Good written and verbal communication

\* Strong organisational and coordination skills

\* Good working knowledge of English

\* Ability to work on\-site

\*\*Good to Have:\*\*

\* Experience managing a brand's social media pages

\* Experience in education, preschool, parenting, lifestyle or personal branding

\* Experience with YouTube content

\* Photography/videography experience

\* Experience with CapCut, VN, Premiere Pro or similar editing software

\* Experience coordinating influencer/creator collaborations

\* Experience working directly with a Founder/entrepreneur

\* Knowledge of Meta Business Suite and social media scheduling tools

\-\-\-

\# What This Role Is NOT

This is \*\*not simply a posting or scheduling job.\*\*

We are not looking for someone who waits for a brief, creates one post and waits for the next instruction.

We are looking for someone who can take ownership and say:

\*\*"Here is our content plan for this week."\*\*

\*\*"This content is performing well — let's create more around it."\*\*

\*\*"Our engagement has dropped — let's analyse why."\*\*

\*\*"There is an opportunity for a collaboration here."\*\*

\*\*"We need to shoot this today."\*\*

\*\*"These are the campaigns we should plan for next month."\*\*

The ideal candidate should be able to \*\*think → plan → coordinate → create → publish → analyse → improve.\*\*

\-\-\-

\# What We Offer

\* Opportunity to work closely with the Founder

\* Hands\-on experience across education, parenting, content and personal branding

\* An in\-house creative and digital environment

\* Support from internal team members for content production and execution

\* Opportunity to take significant ownership of the digital function

\* Opportunity to grow with a growing education and parenting brand

\* Exposure to content strategy, community building, collaborations and digital marketing

\-\-\-

\# Experience

\*\*1–3 years of relevant experience preferred.\*\*

Freshers with exceptional practical skills, strong portfolios and demonstrated social\-media/content experience may also be considered.

\*\*Portfolio / previous work will be given significant importance.\*\*

\-\-\-

\# How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit:

1\. Updated Resume

2\. Portfolio or examples of social media work

3\. Instagram/Facebook pages previously managed, if applicable

4\. Examples of Reels/videos edited or created

5\. YouTube work, if applicable

6\. A brief introduction about yourself

7\. Current location

8\. Current/last drawn salary

9\. Expected salary

10\. Notice period / availability to join

\*\*Please apply only if you are comfortable with an on\-site role and are genuinely interested in content, social media, community building and working closely with a Founder.\*\*

title: Dispatch Network Technician - L1 (Break Fix Support)
description:
**Job Description**
 Note: The job role is Part Time only (On Demand Support)
   

  

 Maintains computing environment by identifying network requirements, installing upgrades, and monitoring network performance.
   

  

**Break\-fix**
**Job Responsibilities:**
* Visually inspecting devices to assess equipment status
* Rebooting routers, servers, storage devices or other equipment
* Providing loop\-back cables in order to test circuits remotely
* Re\-seating or replacing components or cables
* Removing Alternating Current (“AC”) or Direct Current (“DC”) power from equipment
* Cleaning equipment or connectors
* Connecting a client\-provided test set or test router to equipment
* Swapping removable storage media
* Installing or replace modular equipment components
* Dispatching equipment for repair
* Cleaning fibers
* Taking light levels
* Installing loop backs
* Providing planned maintenance or circuit migration support
* Installing Small Form Factor Pluggable (each an “SFP”) or Gigabit Interface Converters (each a “GBIC”)
* Troubleshooting hardware problems on any device
* Racking and de\-racking of any device installed
* Labeling/inventory equipment plus digital picture and serial number recording
* Tape backup: cassette exchange and storage in strongbox
* Power cycling a router, server, switch and soft\-booting a server
* Follow Data Eradication process


**Provisioning**
* Install cables or optics for new circuits
* Re\-connect / disconnect / replace existing circuits
* Testing of cables and optics


**Deployment**
* Physical Cabling
* Cable Management
* Northbound Cabling (Fiber/Copper/Power)
* Rack/Stack/Jack
* Installation Support (PDU, Network Switches, etc.)
* E\-Waste and other clean\-up activities


**Job Requirements**
* Proven experience in a network administrator role
* Hands on experience in networking, routing and switching
* Excellent knowledge of best practices around management, control, and monitoring of server infrastructure
* Experience with firewalls, Internet VPN’s remote implementation, troubleshooting, and problem resolution is desired
* Ability to set up and configure server hardware
* Familiarity with backup and recovery software and methodologies
* Great at organizing, prioritizing and multitasking
* CCNA, Network\+ or equivalent
* BSc degree in Computer Science or related field or equivalent
* Associate's degree (A.A.) or equivalent from three\-year College or technical school with an emphasis in electronics required; Bachelor's Degree preferred

description:
**Who we are** 






 DigiCert is a global leader in intelligent trust. We protect the digital world by ensuring the security, privacy, and authenticity of every interaction. Our AI\-powered DigiCert ONE platform unifies PKI, DNS, and certificate lifecycle management, to secure infrastructure, software, devices, messages, AI content and agents. Learn why more than 100,000 organizations, including 90% of the Fortune 500, choose DigiCert to stop today’s threats and prepare for a quantum\-safe future at www.digicert.com
 





**Job summary** 






 We are seeking a Software Engineer with 2 years\+ of experience to join our Public Trust PKI engineering team. The team develops and maintains certificate issuance that power DigiCert's PKI platform. In this role, you will contribute to backend services responsible for certificate lifecycle operations, working primarily in C\+\+ while collaborating with teams developing Java and Go\-based microservices. You will participate in the design, development, testing, and support of highly available and scalable services operating in a distributed environment.
 




  
 




**What you will do** 




* Design, develop, test, and maintain backend services and components supporting certificate issuance and management workflows.
* Develop and enhance applications primarily in C\+\+.
* Build and consume RESTful APIs across microservice\-based systems.
* Collaborate with product managers, architects, QA engineers, and other development teams to deliver high\-quality solutions.
* Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code following established coding standards and best practices.
* Participate in code reviews to improve code quality, maintainability, and consistency.
* Analyze, troubleshoot, and debug customer\-reported and production issues.
* Diagnose and resolve performance, memory, and scalability issues using debugging and profiling tools.
* Work with Microsoft SQL Server and Cassandra databases to develop and support platform functionality.
* Participate in Agile development processes, sprint planning, and technical discussions.
* Stay current with emerging technologies and engineering best practices.



  
 




**What you will have** 




* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 2\+ years of professional software development experience.
* Strong proficiency in C\+\+ and object\-oriented programming concepts.
* Good understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software design principles.
* Experience developing or consuming REST APIs.
* Understanding of distributed systems and microservices architecture.
* Experience working with relational databases such as Microsoft SQL Server.
* Basic understanding of Docker containers and containerized application deployments.
* Experience using Git\-based source control workflows.
* Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills.
* Good communication and collaboration skills.
* Hands\-on experience with build systems and toolchains such as CMake, Make, MSBuild, GCC/Clang, or Visual Studio.
* Application of secure coding practices and methodologies.
* Knowledge in GO language is an added advantage.



  
 




**Benefits** 




* Generous time off policies
* Top shelf benefits
* Education, wellness and lifestyle support



  
 




 To protect candidate information and maintain a secure hiring process, all applications must be submitted through our careers portal. Resumes or CVs sent directly via email will not be reviewed or considered.

title: Back End Developer
description:
**About the role** 




 We're looking for a backend engineer who can take real ownership of features and modules end\-to\-end \- from schema design to API implementation to production support. You'll work in a codebase built around multi\-tenancy, scoped authorization, and AI\-driven workflows, and contribute to architectural decisions within the direction set by our senior engineers.
 



  





 The work is technically substantial. You'll spend time on genuinely hard problems: multi\-tenant data isolation, permission systems that go beyond simple role checks, integrations with government systems that Indian institutes are required to use, and backend services that support AI\-powered features.
 



  





**What you'll do** 




 • Build backend services in Node.js and NestJS against a PostgreSQL data layer
 



 • Design and implement APIs that serve multiple tenants with logically isolated data
 



 • Work on authorization systems \- scoped role assignments, permission caching, audit logging
 



 • Integrate with external systems including payment gateways, identity providers, communication
 



 platforms, and government services
 



 • Build async workflows using message queues and background workers
 



 • Contribute to backend services that orchestrate AI features (working with LLMs via provider APIs)
 



 • Write tests, review code, participate in architecture discussions
 



 • Support production systems used by real customers \- read logs, debug incidents, own the fixes
 



  





**Required experience** 




 • 3\-5 years of professional Node.js development, with production NestJS experience
 



 • Strong PostgreSQL: schema design, query optimization, indexing, transactions
 



 • Solid understanding of authorization patterns beyond simple role checks (scoped permissions,
 



 hierarchical roles, or equivalent complexity)
 



 • Experience with async workflows \- message queues, background jobs, event\-driven patterns (BullMQ, RabbitMQ, Kafka, or Pub/Sub)
 



 • Redis for caching, sessions, and rate limiting
 



 • Writing and maintaining test suites (unit and integration)
 



 • Production experience: comfortable reading logs, debugging live issues, owning what you ship
 



 • Git\-based collaborative workflow, code review discipline, clear PR descriptions
 



 • Strong written English \- you'll write design notes, PR descriptions, and technical documentation
 



  





**Strongly preferred (any two of these)** 




 • Multi\-tenant SaaS experience \- you should have opinions on schema\-per\-tenant vs database\-per\-
 



 tenant trade\-offs
 



 • Shipped features integrating with LLMs in production (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or equivalent)• Worked in a regulated domain (ed\-tech, fintech, healthcare) where compliance affects data modeling
 



 • Comfortable with modular monolith architecture and microservices
 



  





**Nice to have** 




 • pgvector or another vector database
 



 • Docker and containerized deployments
 



 • Cloud platforms (GCP preferred, AWS or Azure acceptable)
 



 • CI/CD pipelines
 



 • Prior exposure to Indian regulatory frameworks (DPDP, UGC compliance, DigiLocker integrations)
 



 • Experience generating API type definitions from OpenAPI specs, or publishing internal npm packages for cross\-repo type sharing
 



  





**Who thrives in this role** 




 • Engineers who want architectural depth without waiting years to earn it
 



 • People who take ownership seriously \- you're responsible for what you ship, including how it behaves in production
 



 • Engineers who care about code that other people have to read, not just code that works
 



 • Anyone who wants to work on AI\-integrated backends before it becomes standard everywhere.

title: SolarSquare Energy - Software Development Engineer III - Backend Technologies
description:
**Role : Software Development Engineer III (SDE3\)**
**Location : Mumbai / Bangalore \| Experience : 4\+ Years**
**About SolarSquare**
 At SolarSquare we are building the Home\-Energy brand of future India. We help homes switch to rooftop solar and move away from traditional coal electricity. We are a full\-stack D2C residential solar brand \- designing, installing, maintaining (after\-sales) and financing solar systems for home\-owners across India.
   

  

 In 3 years we have scaled to become the leading residential solar brand in India. We are obsessed with quality, customer service and innovating to make it simple for homes to switch to solar. We are looking for leaders to join us in this mission.
   

  

**What This Role Is**
 You are an engineer who leads projects at the scope of a service or major subsystem. That means : when a problem lands on your desk, it's usually ambiguous. Your job is to turn it into a clear problem statement, design a system to solve it, ship it through to production, and own how it behaves once it's there. You'll work with one or two engineers on most projects, and you'll be the technical person product, ops, and other engineering teams talk to about that domain. You're not a senior individual contributor who only writes code for assigned tickets. You're not a tech lead who's stopped writing code. You're the person between those two \- still hands\-on, but increasingly the one shaping what gets built.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Solve 2 \- 4 complex problems a year end\-to\-end : shape the problem, design the system, ship it, monitor it.
* Design single\-service systems independently. Define API contracts, data models, scale and reliability requirements. Document and review your design with peers before building.
* Turn ambiguity into clarity. Take half\-formed product tasks and partner with PMs to define what's actually being built. Push back when the ask doesn't make sense.
* Stay hands\-on. Write code that goes into production. Drive code reviews. Debug across service boundaries. Refactor when the codebase needs it.
* Mentor 1 \- 2 junior engineers. Be someone's first reviewer. Pair when it helps. Take their growth as your responsibility, not a side activity.
* Be in hiring. Interview candidates regularly. Help shape the interview bar for your function.
* Own outcomes, not output. Track the business or operational metric your work moves. If it doesn't move, that's a problem you own \- not a problem you delivered to.


**What We're Looking For**
* Over 4 years of professional experience in software development, specifically focused on solving large\-scale technical challenges.
* Expert\-level proficiency in at least one major programming language (such as Java, GO, Rust, NodeJS etc) with a focus on writing scalable, maintainable, and unit\-tested code.
* Strong command of object\-oriented design, design patterns, and the creation of intuitive class\-level interfaces.
* Hands\-on experience with multi\-threading, concurrency, and Test\-Driven Development (TDD).
* Deep understanding of relational databases (Postgres) and various NoSQL technologies like HBase, Elasticsearch, or Aerospike, Cassandra.
* Comprehensive knowledge of the full software development life cycle on Linux platforms.
* Proven ability to build highly scalable applications that manage complex business logic and massive datasets.
* A proactive, "go\-getter" mindset characterized by high energy and dedication to task ownership.
* Experience thriving in fast\-paced startup environments with a strong sense of commitment and accountability.
* A passionate drive to tackle complex, real\-world problems through innovative engineering.
* You've made and defended technical decisions, picked up problems no one assigned, or built things people use that no one asked for.
* Strong fundamentals in your primary stack \- concurrency, data modeling, debugging across systems, performance work. We're stack\-agnostic for the right person.
* Experience designing systems with explicit attention to scale, reliability, and cost \- not just functional correctness.
* Collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders to monitor project outcomes and iteratively refine features based on real\-world impact.

title: Robotics Engineer
description:
**About Us** 




 We build training data to train the next generation of Vision Language Actions (VLA) and World
 



 Foundation Models (WFMs). It is one of the hardest open problems in physical AI.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 




 You will build hardware systems fast. You will work on real, messy, failure\-prone systems that
 



 need to work reliably. You’ll pick sensors, read datasheets, wire things up, break them, and fix
 



 them repeatedly until they work. You’ll integrate sensors with microcontrollers and single\-board
 



 computers, bring up systems from scratch, and debug across hardware and software
 



 boundaries. Expect to move quickly from idea to prototype, iterate under pressure, and make
 



 pragmatic engineering decisions. You’ll also handle basic 3D design when needed to make
 



 systems usable in the real world. This role is about ownership, where you don’t wait for
 



 instructions, you figure things out and ship working hardware.
 



  





**Who We Want** 




 We’re looking for builders, who should be comfortable getting your hands dirty \- reading
 



 datasheets, debugging hardware issues, and working through ambiguity without step\-by\-step
 



 guidance. You’ve likely built things on your own (robots, IoT systems, embedded projects,
 



 anything real), and you understand how components come together beyond theory. You don’t
 



 give up when things don’t work the first time (they won’t). You can move fast, learn faster, and
 



 care about making things actually work and not just look good on paper.
 



 Bonus if you’ve worked with embedded systems, sensors, or done any kind of full\-stack or
 



 ML\-adjacent work \- but the most important thing is that you can build and figure things out
 



 independently.

title: Pharmacist
description:
**Job Title:** Pharmacist

**Location:** Gurgaon, Haryana  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Reports To:** Pharmacy Manager / Chief Pharmacist

**Job Purpose:** We are looking for a licensed and detail\-oriented Pharmacist to manage our pharmacy operations, dispense medications accurately, and provide excellent patient care. You will be responsible for reviewing prescriptions, advising patients on medicine usage, managing inventory, and ensuring strict compliance with the **Drugs and Cosmetics Act** and other state pharmacy regulations.

**Key Responsibilities1\. Medication Dispensing \& Patient Care**

* **Prescription Review:** Screen prescriptions for correct dosage, potential drug interactions, allergies, and legal validity.
* **Accurate Dispensing:** Accurately compound (if applicable), pack, and label medications as prescribed by registered medical practitioners.
* **Patient Counseling:** Advise patients on correct dosages, side effects, storage conditions, and instructions for chronic disease medications (e.g., diabetes, hypertension).
* **OTC Guidance:** Provide safe and professional guidance on over\-the\-counter (OTC) medicines and healthcare products.

**2\. Inventory \& Stock Management**

* **Stock Monitoring:** Maintain optimum inventory levels, track slow\-moving products, and raise orders to prevent stock\-outs of life\-saving drugs.
* **Expiry Control:** Implement strict **FEFO (First Expired, First Out)** practices to minimize medicine wastage and systematically isolate expired items.
* **Cold Chain Maintenance:** Monitor and log refrigerator temperatures daily to ensure the efficacy of vaccines, insulin, and other temperature\-sensitive medicines.

**3\. Compliance \& Record Keeping**

* **Narcotics Management:** Maintain precise records and registers for Schedule H, H1, and X drugs as per Indian pharmacy laws.
* **Billing \& Systems:** Generate accurate invoices using pharmacy management software (ERP) and process insurance claims where applicable.
* **Audits:** Participate in periodic internal and external stock and regulatory audits.

**Required Qualifications \& Skills**

* **Education:** **B.Pharm (Bachelor of Pharmacy)** or **D.Pharm (Diploma in Pharmacy)** from a PCI\-recognized institution.
* **Licensure:** **Mandatory Active Registration** as a Registered Pharmacist with the **Haryana State Pharmacy Council (HSPC)** or a transferable registration from another state council.
* **Experience:** 1 to 4 years (Freshers are welcome for Junior Pharmacist roles; 2\+ years preferred for Hospital/Senior roles).
* **Technical Skills:** Familiarity with pharmacy retail software (like Marg ERP, eVital, or SAP) and basic MS Office tools.
* **Soft Skills:** High attention to detail, strong communication skills (Hindi \& English), patience, and a service\-oriented mindset.

**Work Environment \& Physical Demands**

* Flexibility to work in **rotational shifts**, including night shifts (especially in 24/7 hospital pharmacies or quick\-commerce dark stores).
* Ability to stand for extended periods during peak pharmacy hours.

title: Product Manager
description:
**About The Team** 




 Are you excited by the idea of building the invisible engines that power great products? The Platform Product team at slice works on internal systems, tooling, workflows, and scalable infrastructure that enable teams across the company to move faster and build better experiences.
 



 We solve complex operational and platform problems across customer support, payments, risk, operations, and internal product ecosystems. Think of us as the circuitry behind the neon sign ⚡
 



 Analytical, systems\-driven, deeply collaborative, and relentlessly curious, our team thrives on creating leverage through technology.
 



  





**About the role** 




 We are looking for a Product Manager who is passionate about building impactful products and solving complex customer and business problems. In this role, you will work closely with engineering, design, analytics, business, and other cross\-functional teams to define product strategy, drive execution, and deliver scalable solutions.
 



 If you enjoy identifying opportunities, understanding user needs, solving problems, and building products that create meaningful impact, we would love to meet you.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 



* Understand pain points, workflows, and operational challenges across internal stakeholders including Operations, Support, Risk, Finance, and Business teams.
* Build scalable internal platforms, tooling, and automation systems that improve productivity and operational efficiency.
* Define and prioritize platform roadmaps aligned with business goals and long\-term architectural vision.
* Work closely with leadership, engineering, design, analytics, and operations teams to drive platform adoption and execution.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort through workflow optimization, integrations, and intelligent automation.
* Own end\-to\-end product lifecycle from problem discovery and requirement gathering to launch and iteration.
* Establish metrics to measure platform effectiveness, operational impact, and stakeholder satisfaction.
* Balance short\-term operational needs with long\-term platform scalability and reliability.
* Drive continuous improvement through fast iterations, experimentation, and stakeholder feedback loops.



  





**What You Will Need** 



* 2–4 years of Product Management experience in high startup environments.
* Strong problem\-solving mindset with the ability to navigate ambiguous and complex operational challenges.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work across technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Experience collaborating closely with engineering, analytics, operations, and design teams.
* Ability to convert fragmented requirements into structured product plans and execution roadmaps.
* Strong understanding of product thinking, prioritization frameworks, and data\-driven decision\-making.
* Bias for action with an ownership mindset and attention to detail.
* Familiarity with workflow automation, platform ecosystems, APIs, or internal operations systems is a plus.



  





**Life at slice** 




  





 Life so good, you’d think we’re kidding:
 


* Competitive salaries. Period.
* An extensive medical insurance that looks out for our employees \& their dependents. We’ll love you and take care of you, our promise.
* Flexible working hours. Just don’t call us at 3AM, we like our sleep schedule.
* Tailored vacation \& leave policies so that you enjoy every important moment in your life.
* A reward system that celebrates hard work and milestones throughout the year. Expect a gift coming your way anytime you kill it here.
* Learning and upskilling opportunities. Seriously, not kidding.
* Good food, games, and a cool office to make you feel like home. An environment so good, you’ll forget the term “colleagues can’t be your friends”.



  





**About us** 




 slice
 



 A new bank for a new India
 



  





 slice’s purpose is to make the world better at using money and time, with a major focus on building the best consumer experience for your money. We’ve all felt how slow, confusing, and complicated banking can be. So, we’re reimagining it. We’re building every product from scratch to be fast, transparent, and feel good, because we believe that the best products transcend demographics, like how great music touches most of us.
 



  





 Our cornerstone products and services: slice savings account, slice UPI credit card, slice UPI, and slice business are designed to be simple, rewarding, and completely in your control. At slice, you’ll get to build things you’d use yourself and shape the future of banking in India. We tailor our working experience with the belief that the present moment is the only real thing in life. And we have harmony in the present the most when we feel happy and successful together.
 



  





 We’re backed by some of the world’s leading investors, including Tiger Global, Insight Partners, Advent International, Blume Ventures, and Gunosy Capital.

title: Product Manager
description:
**About the Client** 




 Our client is a global leading, end\-to\-end enterprise volunteer engagement platform powering over 100 million volunteer hours. They exist to connect communities to events and causes they are passionate about. Used by over 3 million volunteers across 26 different countries, their SaaS platform powers mass volunteer programs across the globe for Not\-for\-Profits, local government, sporting federations, and major events. Our all in one solution helps our clients to recruit, retain, reward and train their volunteers, whilst also ensuring compliance.
 



  





**About Teamified** 




 Teamified is a talent partner helping companies build exceptional remote teams across IT, software, product, and digital innovation. We collaborate with leading enterprises and fast\-
 



 scaling tech businesses worldwide to help them access world class talent and
 



 accelerate growth. With operations across the globe our mission is to make building high
 



 performing global teams simple, fast, and cost\-effective. Teamified has hundreds of clients with more than 200 engineers, testers, product managers,
 



 designers, and technology experts delivering impactful solutions every day.
 



  





**About The Role** 




 We're looking for a mid\-level Product Manager to join us in working directly
 



 with customers to understand their pain points and turning individual asks into solutions that scale across our whole customer base. This role sits across web and mobile, with a strong focus on compliance and platform consistency, and partners closely with Engineering, UX, Solutions Consulting, and Support.
 



  





 This is a role for someone who is genuinely curious about customers and how the product works in their hands, who can hold their own in a triad, and who's comfortable making prioritization calls backed by evidence rather than instinct alone.
 



  





**What you'll work on** 



* Work directly with customers to understand pain points and use cases, with a particular focus on customer\-raised asks and requests
* Translate individual customer problems into solutions that can be rolled out to the broader customer base, not just the requesting account
* Understand and solve for compliance requirements across both web and mobile platforms
* Translate web features into mobile features, ensuring parity and platform\-appropriate design
* Define and prioritize projects and tasks based on evidence and stakeholder consultation
* Proactively report on progress and challenges to stakeholders and leadership
* Own and drive product briefs, working in close collaboration with Engineering, UX, Solutions Consulting (SC), and Support
* Run gap analyses across multiple areas of the platform to identify where it falls short of customer or compliance needs



  





**What you bring** 



* 3\-5 years of experience in Product Management (or equivalent experience translating customer needs into shipped features)
* Genuine curiosity about customers and how they use the product
* Ability to clearly articulate problems, proposed solutions, and recommendations, including the trade\-offs behind them
* Strong communication skills, confident and articulate with customers, internal stakeholders, and engineers alike
* Demonstrated experience working within a triad model (Product, Engineering, UX) and directly with customers
* Solid instincts for user experience, knowing what makes a feature usable, not just functional
* Comfort working across both web and mobile product surfaces



  





**Nice to have** 



* Experience with AI tools applied to product workflows
* Data\-driven decision making
* Experience defining and measuring success metrics for shipped features
* Ability to uncover common themes across disparate customer feedback



  





**Why this role matters** 




 This PM sits close to the customer, translating real, individual problems into solutions that hold up across the whole platform and customer base. The work directly shapes how consistent, compliant, and usable the product feels across web and mobile, and gives you real ownership over problems from discovery through to delivery.
 



  





**Benefits** 



* Flexibility in work hours and location, with a focus on managing energy rather than time.
* Access to online learning platforms and a budget for professional development
* A collaborative, no\-silos environment, encouraging learning and growth across teams
* A dynamic social culture with team lunches, social events, and opportunities for creative input
* Health insurance
* Leave Benefits
* Provident Fund
* Gratuity



 If you possess the required skills and are eager to contribute to our team's success, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.
 **Apply now!** 




 \#GrowWithTeamified \#TeamifyYourCareer

description:
We are looking for a Product Manager to own Meritto's mobile app — used daily by counsellors, marketing teams, institute admins, and outreach teams to manage leads, calls, follow\-ups, and application workflows on the move.
 




  






 This is a full\-time, IC role with high ownership and direct visibility to the Head of Product.
 




  





**What You Will Do** 




  






 ●     Own the mobile product roadmap, aligned to Meritto's platform (CRM, Marketing, Application, Post\-Application, Mio AI)
 





 ●     Identify mobile\-specific opportunities through user research, support ticket analysis, and field visits to institutions
 





 ●     Write crisp PRDs with clear problem statements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and success metrics
 





 ●     Drive sprint planning, backlog grooming, and App Store / Play Store release cycles
 





 ●     Define and instrument key mobile metrics: DAU/MAU, feature adoption, session depth, crash\-free rate, and counsellor productivity KPIs
 





 ●     Work with the Mio AI team to surface AI\-powered nudges and workflow intelligence on mobile
 





 ●     Enable GTM (Sales, CS, Marketing) with clear feature positioning, demo flows, and release communications
 




  









**What we're looking for** 











 ●     3–6 years of product management experience, with at least 2 years owning a mobile product (iOS and/or Android) end\-to\-end
 





 ●     Strong grasp of mobile\-specific constraints: performance, offline behaviour, push notification strategy, deep linking, and app store optimisation
 





 ●     Proven ability to write high\-quality PRDs and translate complex B2B workflows into simple, elegant mobile experiences
 





 ●     Working knowledge of AI/ML concepts and hands\-on experience shipping AI\-powered features on mobile (e.g. intelligent nudges, voice agents, or conversational interfaces)
 





 ●     Data\-driven mindset — comfortable with analytics tools (Amplitude, Mixpanel, Zoho Analytics, or similar) and SQL\-level data exploration
 





 ●     Excellent cross\-functional communication — can align engineering, design, and GTM without authority
 





 ●     Experience in a B2B SaaS environment, ideally with field\-facing or workflow\-heavy user personas
 




  





**Good to Have** 




  






 ●     Familiarity with education technology, CRM, or workflow automation domains
 





 ●     Experience with React Native or hybrid mobile architectures (technical empathy, not coding required)
 





 ●     Prior work on counsellor\-facing or field\-team productivity apps
 




  





  





**Who we are** 





  





**At Meritto we believe in building more than just solutions.** 

 We’re redefining the way education connects with technology. As one of India’Largest Vertical SaaS \+ Embedded Payments platform, we’re on a mission to build the “Digital Backbone of Education Institutions” by simplifying how educational organization runs — from enrollment to lifecycle, advancement to finance, and beyond. Having mastered the art of student acquisition, we’re now expanding our horizons to cover the entire spectrum of running an educational organization—from managing the student lifecycle to driving student success and outcomes.
 








**What’s our work culture like?** 

 We work from the office in a dynamic, inclusive, and merit\-driven space fueled by the energy of collaboration and creativity coming together.

**Description**
 Amazon Application Security is looking for a security\-focused Technical Program Manager who wants to make a difference and support Amazon builders to ensure that protecting customer data is at the forefront of all development.
   

  

 Our team approaches security challenges with empathy and curiosity to help Amazon builders identify areas of improvement and learn how to navigate the highly dynamic space of application security. Amazon Application Security focuses on enabling our builders to provide a secure and trustworthy experience to our customers without compromising the overall customer experience.
   

  

 In this role you will work directly with security teams and Amazon builders providing direct front line support and security expertise to Amazon teams.
   

  

 You’ll also find this role will routinely challenge your background in technical product ownership, process development, operational and management skills, project management, critical thinking, relationship\-building, and problem\-solving. You’ll also find yourself challenged in unique ways when operating at the massive scale of Amazon, unique to a select few corporations in the world. You must be self\-directed and open to new challenges, adept at prioritization, innovation, and collaborating with others.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Plan, organize, and manage all phases of the project lifecycle ensuring successful delivery. This includes defining success criteria, developing and managing project governance plans, project schedules, team goals, communication strategies and project milestones.
* Collaborate with internal customers (senior business leaders, development teams, application security engineering teams and other partner security teams) to understand their needs, their business and how we can improve their security posture.
* Architect and manage internal scope of work documents with the customer clearly defining success criteria and timelines. Hold all stakeholders accountable to these documents through the project lifecycle, escalating as necessary.
* Build and manage relationships with key internal stakeholders and security teams and while advocating on behalf of our customers to deliver on their security goals.
* Guide the evolution and adoption of internal security support solutions, at times with complex priorities, prioritizing the work most beneficial to Amazon builders.
* Use knowledge of software system design to scope architecture, review associated threat models, educate customers on potential severity of security findings and guide developer and security engineering teams through remediation.
* Define and implement best practice methods, processes, tools and continuous improvement initiatives aimed at scaling and increasing the efficiency of Amazon’s security guidance and builder support processes.
* Own the creation and delivery of business proposals (growth, new areas of focus, etc) and metrics to security leadership.
* Proactively identify and manage program risk, identifying paths to overcome risks, and escalating when necessary
* Work effectively and make sound decisions in a dynamic environment with changing priorities.
* Influence, negotiate, resolve conflicts and achieve results through others who are not direct reports.
* Foster a positive work environment leveraging existing skills in active listening, encouraging diverse perspectives and adapting to a variety of personality types.


**About The Team**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why Amazon Security
   

  

 At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, training, and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 3\+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
* 5\+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working with security teams


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers.  Our customers include some of the most recognizable companies in the world, including Costco, HP, Autodesk, Intuit, Nasdaq, ZoomInfo, Sony, Robinhood, Mattel, Riot Games, DoorDash, Takeda, Chipotle, P\&G, and Infosys. Our buyers are privacy officers, general counsel, and engineering leaders. They're sophisticated people who expect substance, and that's exactly what we bring.
 



  





**The Opportunity** 




  





 Privado started as an open source code scanning product for privacy. It reads your codebase, finds personal data, traces how that data moves, catches leaks into logs, and flags privacy issues before anything ships. We've since extended that to web and mobile app scanning, and agentic assessment workflows are next.
 



  





 That's a hard thing to design. The data is dense, the flows are technical, and the people using it are engineers and privacy practitioners who will notice every place the interface makes their job harder. Most privacy software in this category looks like a compliance form, our's shouldn't.
 



  





 You'd be joining a design team of three inside a 60 person company, working directly with product managers, tech leads, and our CEO. Every design project at Privado is open to everyone. If a project interests you and you can make the case for it, you can own it. This is not a role where work gets assigned down to you.
 



  





 We're deliberately hiring at mid level. We want someone with real craft who is still building their range, not someone who has already settled into a process and wants to supervise it.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 




  




1. Product interfaces. Ship production ready UI for complex enterprise flows across our scanning, data mapping, and assessment products. This is hands on interface and visual design, and it's the largest part of the role.
2. Problem definition. Work with product managers and engineers to turn ambiguous problems into clear statements before anyone opens Figma. Bring methods and toolkits for getting a room to agreement.
3. Design quality. Critique our existing product honestly, find what's broken or underbuilt, and turn that into self initiated projects you propose and run.
4. Design culture. Run reviews, raise the bar on craft across teams, and advocate for the user in rooms where nobody else will.
5. Brand and growth work. Occasional, alongside the product team. Optional, and yours if you want it.



  





**What We're Looking For** 




  




1. You bring 2 to 3 years of experience with user experience and interface design as your core skill.
2. You have a strong sense of what an elegant B2B SaaS product feels like, and you can explain why a good one is good rather than just pointing at it.
3. Your design foundations are strong. Typography, hierarchy, layout, systems thinking. Visual and interface craft is a significant part of this role and we will look closely at it.
4. You communicate ideas through user flows, prototypes, wireframes, and high fidelity interfaces. Build your own process however you like, as long as it produces outcomes.
5. You write and speak clearly. We're remote and async, so unclear communication is expensive here in a way it isn't elsewhere.
6. We value skills and potential over formal educational background. Side projects and self directed learning count as much as industry experience.



  





**What Success Looks Like in 90 Days** 




  




1. You've shipped at least one complete flow end to end, from problem statement to production.
2. You know our product well enough to critique it specifically, and you've brought us a list of what's wrong with it.
3. Engineers come to you early rather than after the fact.
4. You've proposed one project that nobody asked you for.



  





**What We Offer** 




  




1. Competitive salary and meaningful equity. ESOPs are on the table for the right candidate.
2. Freedom to choose your hours. We measure outcomes, not hours logged, and we keep meetings to a minimum outside a few shared hours.
3. Work from anywhere. We're 60\+ people across the US, EU, and India. We hire globally and you work locally, whether that's a city centre or a village near the ocean.
4. Unlimited paid time off plus your local holidays. We don't count days.
5. Personal and family medical insurance, a laptop, and a work from home setup grant so your desk is one you can do your best work at.
6. Budget for whatever tools you need.



  





**To Apply** 




  




1. A portfolio is mandatory. Applications without one are not reviewed.
2. Share a URL, or a PDF under 10 MB via Google Drive if you don't have a site. Please don't send raw Figma prototypes. Quality over quantity, and include work you actually want to talk about, because we'll use it as the starting point of the conversation.



  





**Along with your portfolio, tell us three things:** 




  




1. Walk us through the most complex interface you've designed. What made it hard, and what did you do about it?
2. Show us a design decision you got wrong. What did you learn from the users, and what did you change?
3. Pick any B2B product you use regularly and tell us what you'd redesign about it and why.



  





**Hiring Process** 




  





 Round 1\. Exploratory call. Introductions, the role, your background.
 



 Round 2\. Design discussion. What design means to you, and a walkthrough of your work.
 



 Round 3\. Culture conversation. Values and aspirations, and your chance to interview us.
 



  





 Send your portfolio at: rathin.kapadia@privado.ai, nitin.garg@privado.ai

description:

title: Low-Level / Platform Firmware Engineer
description:
**Role : Low\-Level / Platform Firmware Engineer** 




  





**About the Company** 




 Manastu Space is a
 **Space Safety and Logistics company** 
 focused on making space
 **safe, sustainable, and accessible** 
 . We develop technologies to address critical challenges such as
 **space debris mitigation and green propulsion** 
 , enabling safer satellite operations, and long\-term sustainability of the space ecosystem.
 



 Our work sits at the intersection of
 **advanced engineering, applied research, and mission\-critical systems** 
 , requiring deep technical capability and long\-term thinking.
 



**Website:** 
 https://www.manastuspace.com
 



**LinkedIn:** 
 https://www.linkedin.com/company/manastu\-space/
 



**Email:** 
 careers@manastuspace.com
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are seeking a skilled Low\-Level / Platform Firmware Engineer with strong hands\-on experience in 32\-bit microcontroller\-based systems. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in driver development, peripheral interfacing, board bring\-up, and hardware\-level debugging — building the foundation that every layer of application firmware runs on. Experience in aerospace, defence, avionics, or other mission\-critical electronics domains will be highly valued.
 **Role Overview** 



* Department Engineering / Embedded Systems / Avionics \& Defence Electronics
* Experience 2 \- 5 Years of relevant embedded firmware experience
* Qualification B.E. / B.Tech / M.E. / M.Tech — Electronics, Electrical, Embedded Systems, Instrumentation, Computer Science or related discipline
* Domain Preference Aerospace, Defence, Avionics, Space, or Mission\-Critical Systems



**Responsibilities** 



* Develop, test, debug, and maintain embedded firmware for 32\-bit microcontrollers and processors.
* Implement drivers for peripherals including UART, SPI, I²C, CAN, Ethernet, USB, ADC, DAC, PWM, and GPIO.
* Develop low\-level drivers, board support packages (BSPs), and bootloader modules.
* Perform MCU initialization: startup code, linker scripts, clock trees, MPU/cache configuration, and interrupt priority assignment.
* Perform board bring\-up, hardware validation, firmware integration, and system\-level debugging.
* Use lab instruments — DSO, logic analyzer, protocol analyzer, multimeter, function generator, JTAG/SWD debuggers — to characterize and debug issues.
* Diagnose communication failures, timing problems, interrupt latency, noise, grounding issues, and signal integrity faults.
* Review schematics and hardware designs from a firmware integration perspective.
* Support design verification, environmental testing, and EMI/EMC qualification activities.
* Prepare driver\-level design documents, bring\-up reports, debug reports, and release notes.
* Participate in code reviews and unit testing of drivers and low\-level modules.
* Collaborate with the Application Firmware Engineer, hardware, FPGA, and QA teams.



**Qualifications** 



* B.E. / B.Tech / M.E. / M.Tech — Electronics, Electrical, Embedded Systems, Instrumentation, Computer Science or related discipline



**Required Skills** 




 Required Skills \& Experience
 


* Core Programming, Strong proficiency in Embedded C; working knowledge of Python for scripting.
* Solid understanding of MCU architecture: memory map, registers, interrupts, DMA, timers, clocks, watchdogs, low\-power modes.
* Primary experience in bare\-metal firmware development, with the ability to bring drivers up under an RTOS.



 Supported MCU Platforms
 


* ARM Cortex\-M series (STM32, NXP, Microchip SAM / PIC32\)
* Renesas, Infineon, or other equivalent 32\-bit MCU platforms



 RTOS Concepts
 


* ISR\-to\-task handoff and interrupt priority assignment at the driver boundary
* Hardware timer configuration for OS tick and peripheral timing
* Enough working knowledge of task/thread context to hand off a clean, RTOS\-safe driver interface to the application layer



 Communication Protocols
 


* UART, SPI, I²C, CAN / CAN\-FD — register\-level configuration and driver implementation
* RS\-232, RS\-485, Ethernet, USB



 Debugging \& Tooling
 


* JTAG, SWD, breakpoints, watchpoints, memory views, register inspection, trace tools.
* Proficient with lab instruments: DSO, logic analyzer, protocol analyzer, multimeter, function generator.
* Working knowledge of IDEs/toolchains: Keil, IAR, STM32CubeIDE, MPLAB X, Code Composer Studio, GCC, Eclipse.
* Source control: Git.
* Ability to independently read schematics and component datasheets.



**Preferred Skills** 



* Prior experience in aerospace, defense, avionics, space, radar, electronic warfare, or mission\-critical embedded systems.
* Familiarity with MISRA C, MIL\-STD requirements, or RTCA qualification processes.
* Experience with secure boot, firmware upgrade mechanisms, CRC verification, watchdog strategy, and fail safe design.
* Knowledge of high\-reliability and fault\-tolerant embedded design practices.
* EMI/EMC debugging experience and environmental testing support.
* FPGA interface bring\-up and processor\-FPGA communication design.
* Real\-time data acquisition, sensor interfacing, or actuator control experience at the driver level.
* Python or scripting skills for test automation and utility development.
* Exposure to static analysis tools for embedded firmware.
* Programming: Embedded C (primary), C\+\+ (preferred), Python scripting
* RTOS: FreeRTOS.
* Debug Tools: JTAG, SWD, ST\-Link, J\-Link, Lauterbach, XDS, or equivalent
* Lab Instruments: DSO, Logic Analyzer, Protocol Analyzer, Multimeter, Function Generator
* Protocols: UART, SPI, I²C, CAN / CAN\-FD, Ethernet, USB, RS\-232, RS\-485
* Version Control: Git
* Documentation: Design documents, test procedures, traceability docs, technical reports



 Key Competencies
 


* Strong Firmware Fundamentals
* Hardware\-Software Integration
* Hands\-on Debugging \& Problem\-Solving
* Signal Integrity Awareness
* Documentation \& Process Discipline
* Cross\-functional Collaboration
